# Plan Command

This command invokes the **planner** agent to create a comprehensive implementation plan before writing any code.

## What This Command Does

1. **Restate Requirements** - Clarify what needs to be built
2. **Identify Risks** - Surface potential issues and blockers
3. **Create Step Plan** - Break down implementation into phases
4. **Wait for Confirmation** - MUST receive user approval before proceeding

## When to Use

Use `/plan` when:
- Starting a new feature
- Making significant architectural changes
- Working on complex refactoring
- Multiple files/components will be affected
- Requirements are unclear or ambiguous

## How It Works

The planner agent will:

1. **Analyze the request** and restate requirements in clear terms
2. **Break down into phases** with specific, actionable steps
3. **Identify dependencies** between components
4. **Assess risks** and potential blockers
5. **Estimate complexity** (High/Medium/Low)
6. **Present the plan** and WAIT for your explicit confirmation

## Example Usage

```
User: /plan I need to add real-time notifications when markets resolve

Agent (planner):
# Implementation Plan: Real-Time Market Resolution Notifications

## Requirements Restatement
- Send notifications to users when markets they're watching resolve
- Support multiple notification channels (in-app, email, webhook)
- Ensure notifications are delivered reliably
- Include market outcome and user's position result

## Implementation Phases

### Phase 1: Database Schema
- Add notifications table with columns: id, user_id, market_id, type, status, created_at
- Add user_notification_preferences table for channel preferences
- Create indexes on user_id and market_id for performance

### Phase 2: Notification Service
- Create notification service in lib/notifications.ts
- Implement notification queue using BullMQ/Redis
- Add retry logic for failed deliveries
- Create notification templates

### Phase 3: Integration Points
- Hook into market resolution logic (when status changes to "resolved")
- Query all users with positions in market
- Enqueue notifications for each user

### Phase 4: Frontend Components
- Create NotificationBell component in header
- Add NotificationList modal
- Implement real-time updates via Supabase subscriptions
- Add notification preferences page

## Dependencies
- Redis (for queue)
- Email service (SendGrid/Resend)
- Supabase real-time subscriptions

## Risks
- HIGH: Email deliverability (SPF/DKIM required)
- MEDIUM: Performance with 1000+ users per market
- MEDIUM: Notification spam if markets resolve frequently
- LOW: Real-time subscription overhead

## Estimated Complexity: MEDIUM
- Backend: 4-6 hours
- Frontend: 3-4 hours
- Testing: 2-3 hours
- Total: 9-13 hours

**WAITING FOR CONFIRMATION**: Proceed with this plan? (yes/no/modify)
```

## Important Notes

**CRITICAL**: The planner agent will **NOT** write any code until you explicitly confirm the plan with "yes" or "proceed" or similar affirmative response.

If you want changes, respond with:
- "modify: [your changes]"
- "different approach: [alternative]"
- "skip phase 2 and do phase 3 first"

## Integration with Other Commands

After planning:
- Use `/tdd` to implement with test-driven development
- Use `/build-fix` if build errors occur
- Use `/code-review` to review completed implementation

## Related Agents

This command invokes the `planner` agent provided by ECC.

For manual installs, the source file lives at:
`agents/planner.md`

Here's the full plan for your Stocks Portfolio Tracker:

---

## Stocks Portfolio Tracker — Implementation Plan

### Requirements Restatement
- Multi-user stocks portfolio tracker
- Vue 3 + Vite + PWA + Pinia + PrimeVue (JS, no TS)
- Node.js backend with MongoDB (encrypted at rest)
- Yahoo Finance scraping / free API for price data
- Periodic price polling (not WebSocket)
- D3.js for data visualizations

---

### Architecture Overview

```
Frontend (Vue 3 + Vite)          Backend (Node.js + Express)
├── PrimeVue UI components   ←→  ├── REST API
├── Pinia stores                 ├── Auth (JWT)
├── D3 charts                    ├── MongoDB (Mongoose)
└── PWA (offline shell)          ├── Yahoo Finance scraper
                                 └── Cron polling job
```

---

### Phase 1 — Project Scaffold
- Vite + Vue 3 project (JS)
- PrimeVue + PrimeIcons setup
- Pinia store setup
- Vue Router with route guards
- PWA plugin (`vite-plugin-pwa`) — manifest + service worker
- Node.js/Express API with folder structure
- MongoDB connection via Mongoose
- `.env` config for both client + server

---

### Phase 2 — Auth (Multi-user)
- User model (email, hashed password, created)
- Register / Login endpoints (bcrypt + JWT)
- Auth middleware for protected routes
- Pinia `authStore` — token, user, login/logout
- Login + Register pages (PrimeVue forms)
- Route guards on Vue Router

---

### Phase 3 — Portfolio Data Model
MongoDB collections:
- `users` — auth
- `portfolios` — one per user, holds positions
- `positions` — ticker, shares, avg cost, user ref
- `transactions` — buy/sell log (ticker, type, price, shares, date)
- `watchlist` — tickers per user

---

### Phase 4 — Yahoo Finance Integration
- `yahoo-finance2` npm package (maintained, free, no key needed)
- Backend service: `stockService.js`
  - `getQuote(ticker)` — current price, change, %change, volume
  - `getHistory(ticker, range)` — OHLCV data for charts
- Cron job (`node-cron`) — poll prices every 5 min for all active tickers
- Cache quotes in MongoDB or in-memory (avoid hammering Yahoo)

---

### Phase 5 — Core API Endpoints
```
POST   /api/auth/register
POST   /api/auth/login

GET    /api/portfolio              — holdings + current values
POST   /api/portfolio/transaction  — buy/sell
DELETE /api/portfolio/position/:id

GET    /api/stocks/quote/:ticker
GET    /api/stocks/history/:ticker?range=1mo

GET    /api/watchlist
POST   /api/watchlist
DELETE /api/watchlist/:ticker
```

---

### Phase 6 — Frontend Views
| View | Components |
|---|---|
| Dashboard | Total value card, day P&L, top movers, allocation donut (D3) |
| Holdings | PrimeVue DataTable, sortable, P&L per position |
| Stock Detail | D3 line/area chart, quote stats, buy/sell modal |
| Transactions | PrimeVue DataTable with filters |
| Watchlist | Card grid, quick-add to portfolio |
| Auth | Login / Register forms |

---

### Phase 7 — D3 Visualizations
- **Portfolio allocation** — donut chart (by ticker or sector)
- **Portfolio value over time** — area chart (based on transaction history)
- **Stock price history** — line chart on Stock Detail page
- **Day gainers/losers** — horizontal bar chart on Dashboard

---

### Phase 8 — PWA
- App manifest (name, icons, theme color)
- Service worker — cache app shell, offline fallback page
- Install prompt handling

---

### Risks

| Risk | Level | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Yahoo Finance scraping breaks | MEDIUM | `yahoo-finance2` is actively maintained; fallback to Alpha Vantage free tier |
| MongoDB encryption at rest | LOW | Use MongoDB Atlas with encryption-at-rest enabled (free tier supports it) |
| JWT token security | MEDIUM | Short expiry + refresh token or httpOnly cookie |
| D3 + Vue reactivity conflicts | LOW | Wrap D3 in Vue `onMounted` / `watch`, use refs for containers |
| Rate limiting on Yahoo | MEDIUM | Cache aggressively, poll only active tickers |

---

### Folder Structure (proposed)
```
/client        ← Vite + Vue
  /src
    /components
    /views
    /stores      ← Pinia
    /composables
    /charts      ← D3 modules
    /router

/server        ← Node.js + Express
  /routes
  /controllers
  /models       ← Mongoose
  /services     ← stockService, cronJobs
  /middleware   ← auth
```

## Mobile-First Amendments

### PWA Upgrades
- **Bottom navigation bar** (not sidebar) — Dashboard, Holdings, Watchlist, Transactions, Profile
- **Touch-friendly** — large tap targets, swipe gestures (swipe to delete watchlist item, swipe between tabs)
- **Pull-to-refresh** on Holdings and Dashboard
- **Add to Home Screen** prompt — well-timed, not on first load
- **Splash screen** + themed status bar (PrimeVue theme color)
- **Offline shell** — app loads and shows cached data without network
- **Background sync** — queue buy/sell transactions if offline, sync when back online

- All views designed for **375px width first**, scale up to desktop
- PrimeVue components chosen for mobile: `BottomNavigation`, `Drawer` (not Dialog for detail views), `Sheet`-style panels
- D3 charts **responsive** — SVG viewBox scales, simplified on small screens (less axis labels, touch tooltips)
- DataTables → **card list view on mobile**, table on desktop (responsive breakpoint)

```javascript
const mongoose = require('mongoose')
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs')

const userSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    name: { type: String, required: true, trim: true },
    email: { type: String, required: true, unique: true, lowercase: true, trim: true },
    password: { type: String, required: true, minlength: 6 },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
)

userSchema.pre('save', async function (next) {
  if (!this.isModified('password')) return next()
  this.password = await bcrypt.hash(this.password, 12)
  next()
})

userSchema.methods.comparePassword = function (candidate) {
  return bcrypt.compare(candidate, this.password)
}

userSchema.methods.toJSON = function () {
  const obj = this.toObject()
  delete obj.password
  return obj
}

module.exports = mongoose.model('User', userSchema)

```

```javascript
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken')
const User = require('../models/User')

module.exports = async (req, res, next) => {
  const header = req.headers.authorization
  if (!header || !header.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    return res.status(401).json({ message: 'No token provided' })
  }
  const token = header.split(' ')[1]
  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET)
    req.user = await User.findById(decoded.id).select('-password')
    if (!req.user) return res.status(401).json({ message: 'User not found' })
    next()
  } catch {
    res.status(401).json({ message: 'Invalid token' })
  }
}

```

```javascript
const yahooFinance = require('yahoo-finance2').default

const quoteCache = new Map()
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000 // 5 minutes

async function getQuote(ticker) {
  const cached = quoteCache.get(ticker)
  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.ts < CACHE_TTL) return cached.data

  const result = await yahooFinance.quote(ticker, {
    fields: ['symbol', 'shortName', 'regularMarketPrice', 'regularMarketChange',
      'regularMarketChangePercent', 'regularMarketVolume', 'marketCap',
      'regularMarketDayHigh', 'regularMarketDayLow', 'regularMarketOpen',
      'fiftyTwoWeekHigh', 'fiftyTwoWeekLow', 'trailingPE'],
  })

  const data = {
    ticker: result.symbol,
    name: result.shortName,
    price: result.regularMarketPrice,
    change: result.regularMarketChange,
    changePercent: result.regularMarketChangePercent,
    volume: result.regularMarketVolume,
    marketCap: result.marketCap,
    dayHigh: result.regularMarketDayHigh,
    dayLow: result.regularMarketDayLow,
    open: result.regularMarketOpen,
    week52High: result.fiftyTwoWeekHigh,
    week52Low: result.fiftyTwoWeekLow,
    pe: result.trailingPE,
  }

  quoteCache.set(ticker, { data, ts: Date.now() })
  return data
}

async function getQuotes(tickers) {
  return Promise.all(tickers.map((t) => getQuote(t).catch(() => null)))
}

async function getHistory(ticker, range = '3mo') {
  const rangeMap = { '1d': 1, '5d': 5, '1mo': 30, '3mo': 90, '6mo': 180, '1y': 365, '2y': 730 }
  const days = rangeMap[range] || 90
  const startDate = new Date()
  startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days)

  const result = await yahooFinance.historical(ticker, {
    period1: startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
    interval: days <= 5 ? '1h' : '1d',
  })

  return result.map((row) => ({
    date: row.date,
    open: row.open,
    high: row.high,
    low: row.low,
    close: row.close,
    volume: row.volume,
  }))
}

async function searchTicker(query) {
  const results = await yahooFinance.search(query)
  return (results.quotes || [])
    .filter((q) => q.quoteType === 'EQUITY')
    .slice(0, 8)
    .map((q) => ({ ticker: q.symbol, name: q.shortname || q.longname }))
}

module.exports = { getQuote, getQuotes, getHistory, searchTicker }

```

```javascript
const cron = require('node-cron')
const Position = require('../models/Position')
const { getQuotes } = require('./stockService')

function startCronJobs() {
  // Refresh quote cache every 5 minutes during market hours (Mon-Fri 9:30-16:00 ET)
  cron.schedule('*/5 14-21 * * 1-5', async () => {
    try {
      const positions = await Position.distinct('ticker')
      if (positions.length > 0) {
        await getQuotes(positions)
        console.log(`[cron] Refreshed quotes for: ${positions.join(', ')}`)
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[cron] Quote refresh error:', err.message)
    }
  })

  console.log('Cron jobs started')
}

module.exports = { startCronJobs }
```

```javascript
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken')
const User = require('../models/User')

function signToken(id) {
  return jwt.sign({ id }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN })
}

exports.register = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { name, email, password } = req.body
    if (!name || !email || !password)
      return res.status(400).json({ message: 'All fields required' })

    const exists = await User.findOne({ email })
    if (exists) return res.status(409).json({ message: 'Email already registered' })

    const user = await User.create({ name, email, password })
    const token = signToken(user._id)
    res.status(201).json({ token, user })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.login = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { email, password } = req.body
    if (!email || !password)
      return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Email and password required' })

    const user = await User.findOne({ email })
    if (!user || !(await user.comparePassword(password)))
      return res.status(401).json({ message: 'Invalid credentials' })

    const token = signToken(user._id)
    res.json({ token, user })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.me = async (req, res) => {
  res.json({ user: req.user })
}
```

```javascript
const Position = require('../models/Position')
const Transaction = require('../models/Transaction')
const { getQuotes } = require('../services/stockService')

exports.getPortfolio = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const positions = await Position.find({ user: req.user._id })
    if (!positions.length) return res.json({ positions: [], totalValue: 0, totalCost: 0 })

    const tickers = positions.map((p) => p.ticker)
    const quotes = await getQuotes(tickers)
    const quoteMap = {}
    quotes.forEach((q) => { if (q) quoteMap[q.ticker] = q })

    let totalValue = 0
    let totalCost = 0

    const enriched = positions.map((p) => {
      const q = quoteMap[p.ticker] || {}
      const currentPrice = q.price || 0
      const value = currentPrice * p.shares
      const cost = p.avgCost * p.shares
      const pnl = value - cost
      const pnlPercent = cost > 0 ? (pnl / cost) * 100 : 0
      totalValue += value
      totalCost += cost
      return {
        _id: p._id,
        ticker: p.ticker,
        companyName: q.name || p.companyName,
        shares: p.shares,
        avgCost: p.avgCost,
        currentPrice,
        value,
        cost,
        pnl,
        pnlPercent,
        change: q.change,
        changePercent: q.changePercent,
      }
    })

    res.json({
      positions: enriched,
      totalValue,
      totalCost,
      totalPnl: totalValue - totalCost,
      totalPnlPercent: totalCost > 0 ? ((totalValue - totalCost) / totalCost) * 100 : 0,
    })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.addTransaction = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { ticker, type, shares, price, date, notes } = req.body
    if (!ticker || !type || !shares || !price)
      return res.status(400).json({ message: 'ticker, type, shares, price required' })

    const total = shares * price
    const tx = await Transaction.create({
      user: req.user._id, ticker: ticker.toUpperCase(), type, shares, price, total, date, notes,
    })

    let position = await Position.findOne({ user: req.user._id, ticker: ticker.toUpperCase() })

    if (type === 'buy') {
      if (position) {
        const newShares = position.shares + shares
        position.avgCost = (position.avgCost * position.shares + price * shares) / newShares
        position.shares = newShares
        await position.save()
      } else {
        position = await Position.create({
          user: req.user._id, ticker: ticker.toUpperCase(), shares, avgCost: price,
        })
      }
    } else if (type === 'sell') {
      if (!position || position.shares < shares)
        return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Insufficient shares' })
      position.shares -= shares
      if (position.shares === 0) {
        await position.deleteOne()
      } else {
        await position.save()
      }
    }

    res.status(201).json({ transaction: tx })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.getTransactions = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { ticker, type, limit = 50, page = 1 } = req.query
    const filter = { user: req.user._id }
    if (ticker) filter.ticker = ticker.toUpperCase()
    if (type) filter.type = type

    const transactions = await Transaction.find(filter)
      .sort({ date: -1 })
      .skip((page - 1) * limit)
      .limit(Number(limit))

    const total = await Transaction.countDocuments(filter)
    res.json({ transactions, total, page: Number(page), pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.deletePosition = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const position = await Position.findOne({ _id: req.params.id, user: req.user._id })
    if (!position) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Position not found' })
    await position.deleteOne()
    res.json({ message: 'Position removed' })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

```

```javascript
const Watchlist = require('../models/Watchlist')
const { getQuotes } = require('../services/stockService')

exports.getWatchlist = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const items = await Watchlist.find({ user: req.user._id }).sort({ addedAt: -1 })
    if (!items.length) return res.json([])

    const tickers = items.map((i) => i.ticker)
    const quotes = await getQuotes(tickers)
    const quoteMap = {}
    quotes.forEach((q) => { if (q) quoteMap[q.ticker] = q })

    const enriched = items.map((item) => ({
      _id: item._id,
      ticker: item.ticker,
      companyName: item.companyName,
      addedAt: item.addedAt,
      ...(quoteMap[item.ticker] || {}),
    }))

    res.json(enriched)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.addToWatchlist = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { ticker, companyName } = req.body
    if (!ticker) return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Ticker required' })

    const exists = await Watchlist.findOne({ user: req.user._id, ticker: ticker.toUpperCase() })
    if (exists) return res.status(409).json({ message: 'Already in watchlist' })

    const item = await Watchlist.create({
      user: req.user._id, ticker: ticker.toUpperCase(), companyName,
    })
    res.status(201).json(item)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.removeFromWatchlist = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const item = await Watchlist.findOne({ _id: req.params.id, user: req.user._id })
    if (!item) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Not found' })
    await item.deleteOne()
    res.json({ message: 'Removed from watchlist' })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}
```

```javascript
import { createRouter, createWebHistory } from 'vue-router'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'

const routes = [
  { path: '/login', name: 'Login', component: () => import('@/views/LoginView.vue'), meta: { guest: true } },
  { path: '/register', name: 'Register', component: () => import('@/views/RegisterView.vue'), meta: { guest: true } },
  {
    path: '/',
    component: () => import('@/layouts/MobileLayout.vue'),
    meta: { requiresAuth: true },
    children: [
      { path: '', name: 'Dashboard', component: () => import('@/views/DashboardView.vue') },
      { path: 'holdings', name: 'Holdings', component: () => import('@/views/HoldingsView.vue') },
      { path: 'watchlist', name: 'Watchlist', component: () => import('@/views/WatchlistView.vue') },
      { path: 'transactions', name: 'Transactions', component: () => import('@/views/TransactionsView.vue') },
      { path: 'stock/:ticker', name: 'StockDetail', component: () => import('@/views/StockDetailView.vue') },
      { path: 'profile', name: 'Profile', component: () => import('@/views/ProfileView.vue') },
    ],
  },
  { path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', redirect: '/' },
]

const router = createRouter({
  history: createWebHistory(),
  routes,
  scrollBehavior: () => ({ top: 0 }),
})

router.beforeEach((to) => {
  const auth = useAuthStore()
  if (to.meta.requiresAuth && !auth.token) return { name: 'Login' }
  if (to.meta.guest && auth.token) return { name: 'Dashboard' }
})

export default router
```

```javascript
import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'

export const useAuthStore = defineStore('auth', () => {
  const token = ref(localStorage.getItem('token') || null)
  const user = ref(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || 'null'))

  const isAuthenticated = computed(() => !!token.value)

  function setAuth(t, u) {
    token.value = t
    user.value = u
    localStorage.setItem('token', t)
    localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(u))
  }

  async function login(email, password) {
    const data = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password })
    setAuth(data.token, data.user)
    return data
  }

  async function register(name, email, password) {
    const data = await api.post('/auth/register', { name, email, password })
    setAuth(data.token, data.user)
    return data
  }

  function logout() {
    token.value = null
    user.value = null
    localStorage.removeItem('token')
    localStorage.removeItem('user')
  }

  return { token, user, isAuthenticated, login, register, logout }
})

```

```javascript
import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'

export const usePortfolioStore = defineStore('portfolio', () => {
  const positions = ref([])
  const totalValue = ref(0)
  const totalCost = ref(0)
  const totalPnl = ref(0)
  const totalPnlPercent = ref(0)
  const loading = ref(false)

  async function fetchPortfolio() {
    loading.value = true
    try {
      const data = await api.get('/portfolio')
      positions.value = data.positions
      totalValue.value = data.totalValue
      totalCost.value = data.totalCost
      totalPnl.value = data.totalPnl
      totalPnlPercent.value = data.totalPnlPercent
    } finally {
      loading.value = false
    }
  }

  async function addTransaction(payload) {
    const data = await api.post('/portfolio/transaction', payload)
    await fetchPortfolio()
    return data
  }

  async function deletePosition(id) {
    await api.delete(`/portfolio/position/${id}`)
    await fetchPortfolio()
  }

  return { positions, totalValue, totalCost, totalPnl, totalPnlPercent, loading, fetchPortfolio, addTransaction, deletePosition }
})
```

```javascript
import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'

export const useWatchlistStore = defineStore('watchlist', () => {
  const items = ref([])
  const loading = ref(false)

  async function fetchWatchlist() {
    loading.value = true
    try {
      items.value = await api.get('/watchlist')
    } finally {
      loading.value = false
    }
  }

  async function addItem(ticker, companyName) {
    const item = await api.post('/watchlist', { ticker, companyName })
    items.value.unshift(item)
    return item
  }

  async function removeItem(id) {
    await api.delete(`/watchlist/${id}`)
    items.value = items.value.filter((i) => i._id !== id)
  }

  return { items, loading, fetchWatchlist, addItem, removeItem }
})
```

```javascript
const BASE = '/api'

function getToken() {
  return localStorage.getItem('token')
}

async function request(method, path, body) {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
  const token = getToken()
  if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`

  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  })

  if (res.status === 401) {
    localStorage.removeItem('token')
    localStorage.removeItem('user')
    window.location.href = '/login'
    return
  }

  const data = await res.json()
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Request failed')
  return data
}

export default {
  get: (path) => request('GET', path),
  post: (path, body) => request('POST', path, body),
  delete: (path) => request('DELETE', path),
  put: (path, body) => request('PUT', path, body),
}

```

```javascript
export function useCurrency(val, currency = 'USD') {
  if (val == null) return '—'
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency, minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(val)
}

export function usePercent(val) {
  if (val == null) return '—'
  const sign = val >= 0 ? '+' : ''
  return `${sign}${val.toFixed(2)}%`
}

export function useLargeNumber(val) {
  if (val == null) return '—'
  if (val >= 1e12) return `$${(val / 1e12).toFixed(2)}T`
  if (val >= 1e9) return `$${(val / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`
  if (val >= 1e6) return `$${(val / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`
  return useCurrency(val)
}

export function gainLossClass(val) {
  if (val == null) return ''
  return val >= 0 ? 'gain' : 'loss'
}
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'

const route = useRoute()

const tabs = [
  { name: 'Dashboard', to: '/', icon: 'pi pi-chart-bar', label: 'Dashboard' },
  { name: 'Holdings', to: '/holdings', icon: 'pi pi-briefcase', label: 'Holdings' },
  { name: 'Watchlist', to: '/watchlist', icon: 'pi pi-eye', label: 'Watchlist' },
  { name: 'Transactions', to: '/transactions', icon: 'pi pi-list', label: 'History' },
  { name: 'Profile', to: '/profile', icon: 'pi pi-user', label: 'Profile' },
]

function isActive(tab) {
  if (tab.to === '/') return route.path === '/'
  return route.path.startsWith(tab.to)
}
</script>

<template>
  <nav class="bottom-nav">
    <RouterLink
      v-for="tab in tabs"
      :key="tab.name"
      :to="tab.to"
      class="nav-item"
      :class="{ active: isActive(tab) }"
    >
      <i :class="tab.icon" />
      <span>{{ tab.label }}</span>
    </RouterLink>
  </nav>
</template>

<style scoped>
.bottom-nav {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useConfirm } from 'primevue/useconfirm'
import { usePortfolioStore } from '@/stores/portfolio'
import { useCurrency, usePercent, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'

import AddTransactionModal from '@/components/ui/AddTransactionModal.vue'

const router = useRouter()

const confirm = useConfirm()
const portfolio = usePortfolioStore()
const showModal = ref(false)

onMounted(() => portfolio.fetchPortfolio())

function confirmDelete(pos) {
  confirm.require({
    message: `Remove ${pos.ticker} from your portfolio?`,
    header: 'Confirm',
    icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
    acceptClass: 'p-button-danger',
    accept: async () => {
      await portfolio.deletePosition(pos._id)
      toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Removed', life: 2000 })
    },
  })
}
</script>

            <span :class="gainLossClass(pos.pnl)" class="pnl">
              {{ useCurrency(pos.pnl) }} ({{ usePercent(pos.pnlPercent) }})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pos-details">
          <div class="detail">
            <span class="text-muted">Shares</span>
            <span>{{ pos.shares }}</span>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useCurrency, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Tag from 'primevue/tag'

const transactions = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)

onMounted(async () => {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const data = await api.get('/portfolio/transactions?limit=100')
    transactions.value = data.transactions
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
})

function formatDate(d) {
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="transactions">
    <header class="page-header">
      <h1>History</h1>
    </header>

    <div v-if="loading" class="text-muted">Loading...</div>

    <div v-else-if="!transactions.length" class="empty">
      <i class="pi pi-list" />
      <p class="text-muted">No transactions yet</p>
    </div>

    <div v-else class="tx-list">
      <div v-for="tx in transactions" :key="tx._id" class="tx-row">
        <div class="tx-left">
          <span class="ticker">{{ tx.ticker }}</span>
          <span class="tx-date text-muted">{{ formatDate(tx.date) }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="tx-mid">
          <span class="text-muted">{{ tx.shares }} shares @ {{ useCurrency(tx.price) }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="tx-right">
          <Tag :value="tx.type.toUpperCase()" :severity="tx.type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'" />
          <span class="total">{{ useCurrency(tx.total) }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.transactions { padding: 1rem; }
.page-header { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useCurrency, usePercent, useLargeNumber, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import { useWatchlistStore } from '@/stores/watchlist'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import SelectButton from 'primevue/selectbutton'
import StockChart from '@/components/charts/StockChart.vue'
import AddTransactionModal from '@/components/ui/AddTransactionModal.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const toast = useToast()
const watchlist = useWatchlistStore()

const ticker = ref(route.params.ticker?.toUpperCase())
const quote = ref(null)
const history = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)
const showTxModal = ref(false)

const ranges = ['1d', '5d', '1mo', '3mo', '6mo', '1y']
const selectedRange = ref('3mo')

async function loadData() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const [q, h] = await Promise.all([
      api.get(`/stocks/quote/${ticker.value}`),
      api.get(`/stocks/history/${ticker.value}?range=${selectedRange.value}`),
    ])
    quote.value = q
    history.value = h
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Failed to load', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(loadData)
watch(selectedRange, loadData)
watch(() => route.params.ticker, (t) => { ticker.value = t?.toUpperCase(); loadData() })

async function toggleWatchlist() {
  const existing = watchlist.items.find((i) => i.ticker === ticker.value)
  if (existing) {
    await watchlist.removeItem(existing._id)
    toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Removed from watchlist', life: 2000 })
  } else {
    await watchlist.addItem(ticker.value, quote.value?.name)
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Added to watchlist', life: 2000 })
  }
}

const isWatched = () => watchlist.items.some((i) => i.ticker === ticker.value)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="stock-detail">
    <header class="detail-header">
      <Button icon="pi pi-arrow-left" text rounded @click="router.back()" />
      <div class="header-info">
        <h1>{{ ticker }}</h1>
        <span class="text-muted">{{ quote?.name }}</span>
      </div>
      <Button
        :icon="isWatched() ? 'pi pi-eye-slash' : 'pi pi-eye'"
        text rounded
        @click="toggleWatchlist"
      />
    </header>

    <div v-if="quote" class="quote-summary">
      <p class="current-price">{{ useCurrency(quote.price) }}</p>
      <p :class="gainLossClass(quote.change)" class="price-change">
        {{ useCurrency(quote.change) }} ({{ usePercent(quote.changePercent) }})
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="range-selector">
      <SelectButton v-model="selectedRange" :options="ranges" />
    </div>

    <StockChart :data="history" :loading="loading" />

    <div v-if="quote" class="stats-grid">
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">Open</span>
        <span>{{ useCurrency(quote.open) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">Day High</span>
        <span>{{ useCurrency(quote.dayHigh) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">Day Low</span>
        <span>{{ useCurrency(quote.dayLow) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">Volume</span>
        <span>{{ useLargeNumber(quote.volume) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">Mkt Cap</span>
        <span>{{ useLargeNumber(quote.marketCap) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">P/E</span>
        <span>{{ quote.pe?.toFixed(2) || '—' }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">52W High</span>
        <span>{{ useCurrency(quote.week52High) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <span class="text-muted">52W Low</span>
        <span>{{ useCurrency(quote.week52Low) }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="action-bar">
      <Button label="Buy" severity="success" fluid @click="showTxModal = true" />
    </div>

    <AddTransactionModal v-model:visible="showTxModal" :default-ticker="ticker" />
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
import * as d3 from 'd3'

const props = defineProps({
  data: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  loading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
})

const svgRef = ref(null)
const tooltipRef = ref(null)
const containerRef = ref(null)

function draw() {
  if (!svgRef.value || !props.data.length) return

  const svg = d3.select(svgRef.value)
  svg.selectAll('*').remove()

  const container = containerRef.value
  const W = container.clientWidth
  const H = 220
  const margin = { top: 10, right: 12, bottom: 30, left: 55 }
  const w = W - margin.left - margin.right
  const h = H - margin.top - margin.bottom

  svg.attr('width', W).attr('height', H)

  const g = svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`)

  const parsed = props.data.map((d) => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))

  const x = d3.scaleTime().domain(d3.extent(parsed, (d) => d.date)).range([0, w])
  const y = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([d3.min(parsed, (d) => d.close) * 0.998, d3.max(parsed, (d) => d.close) * 1.002])
    .range([h, 0])

  const first = parsed[0]?.close
  const last = parsed[parsed.length - 1]?.close
  const isUp = last >= first
  const color = isUp ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444'
  const fillColor = isUp ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)'

  // Grid lines
  g.append('g')
    .attr('class', 'grid')
    .call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(4).tickSize(-w).tickFormat(''))
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('.tick line').attr('stroke', '#334155').attr('stroke-dasharray', '2,4'))

  // Area fill
  const area = d3.area()
    .x((d) => x(d.date))
    .y0(h)
    .y1((d) => y(d.close))
    .curve(d3.curveMonotoneX)

  g.append('path').datum(parsed).attr('fill', fillColor).attr('d', area)

  // Line
  const line = d3.line()
    .x((d) => x(d.date))
    .y((d) => y(d.close))
    .curve(d3.curveMonotoneX)

  g.append('path')
    .datum(parsed)
    .attr('fill', 'none')
    .attr('stroke', color)
    .attr('stroke-width', 1.5)
    .attr('d', line)

  // X axis
  g.append('g')
    .attr('transform', `translate(0,${h})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(x).ticks(5).tickFormat(d3.timeFormat('%b %d')))
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('.tick line').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('text').attr('fill', '#94a3b8').attr('font-size', '10'))

  // Y axis
  g.append('g')
    .call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(4).tickFormat((d) => `$${d3.format(',.0f')(d)}`))
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('.tick line').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('text').attr('fill', '#94a3b8').attr('font-size', '10'))

  // Crosshair + tooltip
  const bisect = d3.bisector((d) => d.date).left
  const focus = g.append('g').style('display', 'none')
  focus.append('line').attr('class', 'crosshair-x').attr('y1', 0).attr('y2', h)
    .attr('stroke', '#94a3b8').attr('stroke-dasharray', '3,3').attr('stroke-width', 1)
  focus.append('circle').attr('r', 4).attr('fill', color).attr('stroke', '#0f172a').attr('stroke-width', 2)

  const tooltip = d3.select(tooltipRef.value)

  svg.append('rect')
    .attr('width', W).attr('height', H).attr('fill', 'none').attr('pointer-events', 'all')
    .on('mousemove touchmove', (event) => {
      const [mx] = d3.pointer(event)
      const adjusted = mx - margin.left
      const date = x.invert(adjusted)
      const i = bisect(parsed, date, 1)
      const d0 = parsed[i - 1]
      const d1 = parsed[i]
      if (!d0 && !d1) return
      const d = d1 && date - d0?.date > d1?.date - date ? d1 : d0
      if (!d) return

      focus.style('display', null)
      focus.select('circle').attr('cx', x(d.date)).attr('cy', y(d.close))
      focus.select('.crosshair-x').attr('x1', x(d.date)).attr('x2', x(d.date))

      tooltip
        .style('display', 'block')
        .style('left', `${Math.min(x(d.date) + margin.left + 10, W - 130)}px`)
        .style('top', `${y(d.close) + margin.top - 20}px`)
        .html(`
          <div class="tt-date">${new Date(d.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}</div>
          <div class="tt-price">$${d.close.toFixed(2)}</div>
        `)
    })
    .on('mouseleave touchend', () => {
      focus.style('display', 'none')
      tooltip.style('display', 'none')
    })
}

onMounted(() => { nextTick(draw) })
watch(() => [props.data, props.loading], () => nextTick(draw))

const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => nextTick(draw))
onMounted(() => { if (containerRef.value) ro.observe(containerRef.value) })
onUnmounted(() => ro.disconnect())
</script>

<template>
  <div ref="containerRef" class="chart-container">
    <div v-if="loading" class="chart-loading">
      <i class="pi pi-spin pi-spinner" />
    </div>
    <div v-else-if="!data.length" class="chart-empty text-muted">No data</div>
    <template v-else>
      <svg ref="svgRef" />
      <div ref="tooltipRef" class="chart-tooltip" style="display:none;" />
    </template>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.chart-container { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 220px; }
.chart-loading, .chart-empty { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 220px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 1.5rem; }
svg { display: block; width: 100%; }
</style>

<style>
.chart-tooltip {
  position: absolute;
  background: #1e293b;
  border: 1px solid #334155;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.tt-date { color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.tt-price { color: #f1f5f9; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
</style>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
import * as d3 from 'd3'
import { useCurrency } from '@/composables/useFormat'

const props = defineProps({
  positions: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
})

const svgRef = ref(null)

const COLORS = ['#3b82f6','#22c55e','#f59e0b','#ef4444','#8b5cf6','#06b6d4','#ec4899','#84cc16']

function draw() {
  if (!svgRef.value || !props.positions.length) return

  const svg = d3.select(svgRef.value)
  svg.selectAll('*').remove()

  const W = 280
  const H = 200
  const radius = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 10
  const innerRadius = radius * 0.55

  svg.attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${W} ${H}`).attr('width', '100%').attr('height', H)

  const g = svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(${W / 2},${H / 2})`)

  const pie = d3.pie().value((d) => d.value).sort(null)
  const arc = d3.arc().innerRadius(innerRadius).outerRadius(radius).cornerRadius(3).padAngle(0.02)
  const hoverArc = d3.arc().innerRadius(innerRadius).outerRadius(radius + 6).cornerRadius(3).padAngle(0.02)

  const data = props.positions.map((p, i) => ({
    ticker: p.ticker,
    value: p.value,
    color: COLORS[i % COLORS.length],
  }))

  const arcs = g.selectAll('.arc').data(pie(data)).enter().append('g').attr('class', 'arc')

  arcs.append('path')
    .attr('fill', (d) => d.data.color)
    .attr('d', arc)
    .style('cursor', 'pointer')
    .on('mouseover', function (_, d) { d3.select(this).attr('d', hoverArc) })
    .on('mouseout', function (_, d) { d3.select(this).attr('d', arc) })

  // Center label
  const total = d3.sum(data, (d) => d.value)
  g.append('text').attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('dy', '-0.2em')
    .attr('fill', '#94a3b8').attr('font-size', '11')
    .text('Total')
  g.append('text').attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('dy', '1em')
    .attr('fill', '#f1f5f9').attr('font-size', '14').attr('font-weight', '600')
    .text(useCurrency(total))
}

onMounted(() => nextTick(draw))
watch(() => props.positions, () => nextTick(draw), { deep: true })
</script>

<template>
  <div v-if="positions.length" class="allocation-wrap">
    <h2 class="section-title">Allocation</h2>
    <div class="chart-row">
      <svg ref="svgRef" />
      <div class="legend">
        <div v-for="(pos, i) in positions" :key="pos.ticker" class="legend-item">
          <span class="legend-dot" :style="{ background: ['#3b82f6','#22c55e','#f59e0b','#ef4444','#8b5cf6','#06b6d4','#ec4899','#84cc16'][i % 8] }" />
          <span class="legend-ticker">{{ pos.ticker }}</span>
          <span class="legend-pct text-muted">{{ pos.value && positions.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.value,0) > 0 ? ((pos.value / positions.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.value,0)) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : '' }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { usePortfolioStore } from '@/stores/portfolio'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog'
import InputText from 'primevue/inputtext'
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber'
import SelectButton from 'primevue/selectbutton'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import AutoComplete from 'primevue/autocomplete'

const props = defineProps({
  visible: Boolean,
  defaultTicker: { type: String, default: '' },
})
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible'])

const toast = useToast()
const portfolio = usePortfolioStore()

const type = ref('buy')
const ticker = ref('')
const shares = ref(null)
const price = ref(null)
const loading = ref(false)
const suggestions = ref([])

watch(() => props.visible, (v) => {
  if (v) {
    ticker.value = props.defaultTicker || ''
    shares.value = null
    price.value = null
    type.value = 'buy'
  }
})

async function searchTicker(event) {
  if (!event.query || event.query.length < 1) { suggestions.value = []; return }
  try {
    const results = await api.get(`/stocks/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(event.query)}`)
    suggestions.value = results.map((r) => ({ label: `${r.ticker} — ${r.name}`, value: r.ticker }))
  } catch { suggestions.value = [] }
}

async function submit() {
  const t = typeof ticker.value === 'object' ? ticker.value.value : ticker.value
  if (!t || !shares.value || !price.value) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Fill all fields', life: 2000 })
    return
  }
  loading.value = true
  try {
    await portfolio.addTransaction({ ticker: t, type: type.value, shares: shares.value, price: price.value })
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: `${type.value === 'buy' ? 'Bought' : 'Sold'} ${t}`, life: 2000 })
    emit('update:visible', false)
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog
    :visible="visible"
    @update:visible="emit('update:visible', $event)"
    modal
    :header="type === 'buy' ? 'Buy Stock' : 'Sell Stock'"
    :style="{ width: '95vw', maxWidth: '420px' }"
    :draggable="false"
  >
    <div class="tx-form">
      <SelectButton v-model="type" :options="['buy', 'sell']" class="type-select" />

      <div class="field">
        <label>Ticker</label>
        <AutoComplete
          v-model="ticker"
          :suggestions="suggestions"
          option-label="label"
          @complete="searchTicker"
          placeholder="AAPL, TSLA..."
          fluid
          force-selection
        />
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Shares</label>
        <InputNumber v-model="shares" :min="0.001" :max-fraction-digits="4" placeholder="0" fluid />
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Price per share</label>
        <InputNumber v-model="price" mode="currency" currency="USD" :min="0.01" :max-fraction-digits="4" placeholder="$0.00" fluid />
      </div>

      <div class="total-row" v-if="shares && price">
        <span class="text-muted">Total</span>
        <span>${{ (shares * price).toFixed(2) }}</span>
      </div>

      <Button
        :label="type === 'buy' ? 'Buy' : 'Sell'"
        :severity="type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'"
        :loading="loading"
        fluid
        @click="submit"
      />
    </div>
  </Dialog>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useWatchlistStore } from '@/stores/watchlist'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import AutoComplete from 'primevue/autocomplete'

const props = defineProps({ visible: Boolean })
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible'])

const toast = useToast()
const watchlist = useWatchlistStore()

const ticker = ref('')
const suggestions = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)

watch(() => props.visible, (v) => { if (v) ticker.value = '' })

async function searchTicker(event) {
  if (!event.query) { suggestions.value = []; return }
  try {
    const results = await api.get(`/stocks/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(event.query)}`)
    suggestions.value = results.map((r) => ({ label: `${r.ticker} — ${r.name}`, value: r.ticker, name: r.name }))
  } catch { suggestions.value = [] }
}

async function submit() {
  const t = typeof ticker.value === 'object' ? ticker.value.value : ticker.value
  const name = typeof ticker.value === 'object' ? ticker.value.name : ''
  if (!t) { toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Enter a ticker', life: 2000 }); return }
  loading.value = true
  try {
    await watchlist.addItem(t, name)
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: `${t} added to watchlist`, life: 2000 })
    emit('update:visible', false)
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog
    :visible="visible"
    @update:visible="emit('update:visible', $event)"
    modal
    header="Add to Watchlist"
    :style="{ width: '95vw', maxWidth: '380px' }"
    :draggable="false"
  >
    <div class="form">
      <div class="field">
        <label>Search ticker or company</label>
        <AutoComplete
          v-model="ticker"
          :suggestions="suggestions"
          option-label="label"
          @complete="searchTicker"
          placeholder="AAPL, Apple..."
          fluid
          force-selection
        />
      </div>
      <Button label="Add to Watchlist" :loading="loading" fluid @click="submit" />
    </div>
  </Dialog>
</template>

<style scoped>
.form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }
.field label { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
</style>

```

_**User (2026-06-02 21:54:10Z)**_

how to seach TLV:POLI

---

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-02 21:54:16Z)**_

Yahoo Finance uses a different format for Tel Aviv Stock Exchange tickers — it's `POLI.TA` not `TLV:POLI`. The `.TA` suffix is the Yahoo Finance convention for TASE stocks.

Try typing **`POLI.TA`** in the search box.

Other common TASE examples:
| TASE | Yahoo Finance |
|---|---|
| TLV:POLI | `POLI.TA` |
| TLV:TEVA | `TEVA` (dual listed, use as-is) |
| TLV:NICE | `NICE` (dual listed) |
| TLV:ESLT | `ESLT.TA` |

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-02 22:04:41Z)**_

The quote cache is serving the old price. When a position is deleted and re-added, the cache still has the stale value for up to 5 minutes. Easiest fix — clear the cache entry when a transaction is added.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-02 22:04:42Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="Read"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Read**</summary>

```text
1	const YahooFinance = require('yahoo-finance2').default
2	const yahooFinance = new YahooFinance()
3	
4	const quoteCache = new Map()
5	const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000 // 5 minutes
6	
7	async function getQuote(ticker) {
8	  const cached = quoteCache.get(ticker)
9	  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.ts < CACHE_TTL) return cached.data
10	
11	  const result = await yahooFinance.quote(ticker)
12	
13	  const data = {
14	    ticker: result.symbol,
15	    name: result.shortName,
16	    price: result.regularMarketPrice,
17	    change: result.regularMarketChange,
18	    changePercent: result.regularMarketChangePercent,
19	    volume: result.regularMarketVolume,
20	    marketCap: result.marketCap,
21	    dayHigh: result.regularMarketDayHigh,
22	    dayLow: result.regularMarketDayLow,
23	    open: result.regularMarketOpen,
24	    week52High: result.fiftyTwoWeekHigh,
25	    week52Low: result.fiftyTwoWeekLow,
26	    pe: result.trailingPE,
27	  }
28	
29	  quoteCache.set(ticker, { data, ts: Date.now() })
30	  return data
31	}
32	
33	async function getQuotes(tickers) {
34	  return Promise.all(tickers.map((t) => getQuote(t).catch(() => null)))
35	}
36	
37	async function getHistory(ticker, range = '3mo') {
38	  const rangeMap = { '1d': 1, '5d': 5, '1mo': 30, '3mo': 90, '6mo': 180, '1y': 365, '2y': 730 }
39	  const days = rangeMap[range] || 90
40	  const endDate = new Date()
41	  const startDate = new Date()
42	  startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days)
43	
44	  const fmt = (d) => d.toISOString().split('T')[0]
45	
46	  const result = await yahooFinance.historical(ticker, {
47	    period1: fmt(startDate),
48	    period2: fmt(endDate),
49	    interval: '1d',
50	  })
51	
52	  return result.map((row) => ({
53	    date: row.date,
54	    open: row.open,
55	    high: row.high,
56	    low: row.low,
57	    close: row.close,
58	    volume: row.volume,
59	  }))
60	}
61	
62	async function searchTicker(query) {

64	  return (results.quotes || [])

66	    .slice(0, 8)
67	    .map((q) => ({ ticker: q.symbol, name: q.shortname || q.longname }))
```

```text
7	async function getQuote(ticker) {
8	  const cached = quoteCache.get(ticker)
9	  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.ts < CACHE_TTL) return cached.data
10	
11	  const result = await yahooFinance.quote(ticker)
12	
13	  const data = {

15	    name: result.shortName,
16	    price: result.regularMarketPrice,
17	    change: result.regularMarketChange,

24	    week52High: result.fiftyTwoWeekHigh,
25	    week52Low: result.fiftyTwoWeekLow,
26	    pe: result.trailingPE,
27	  }
28	
29	  quoteCache.set(ticker, { data, ts: Date.now() })

31	}

33	async function getQuotes(tickers) {

37	async function getHistory(ticker, range = '3mo') {
38	  const rangeMap = { '1d': 1, '5d': 5, '1mo': 30, '3mo': 90, '6mo': 180, '1y': 365, '2y': 730 }
39	  const days = rangeMap[range] || 90
40	  const endDate = new Date()
41	  const startDate = new Date()
42	  startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days)
43	
44	  const fmt = (d) => d.toISOString().split('T')[0]
45	
46	  const result = await yahooFinance.historical(ticker, {
47	    period1: fmt(startDate),
48	    period2: fmt(endDate),
49	    interval: '1d',
50	  })
51	
52	  return result.map((row) => ({
53	    date: row.date,
54	    open: row.open,
55	    high: row.high,
56	    low: row.low,
57	    close: row.close,
58	    volume: row.volume,
59	  }))
60	}
61
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
import * as d3 from 'd3'

const props = defineProps({
  data: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  loading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  mode: { type: String, default: 'line' }, // 'line' | 'candle'
})

const svgRef = ref(null)
const tooltipRef = ref(null)
const containerRef = ref(null)

function draw() {
  if (!svgRef.value || !props.data.length) return

  const svg = d3.select(svgRef.value)
  svg.selectAll('*').remove()

  const W = containerRef.value.clientWidth
  const H = 240
  const margin = { top: 10, right: 12, bottom: 30, left: 60 }
  const w = W - margin.left - margin.right
  const h = H - margin.top - margin.bottom

  svg.attr('width', W).attr('height', H)
  const g = svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`)

  const parsed = props.data.map((d) => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date) }))

  const x = d3.scaleTime().domain(d3.extent(parsed, (d) => d.date)).range([0, w])
  const yMin = d3.min(parsed, (d) => props.mode === 'candle' ? d.low : d.close)
  const yMax = d3.max(parsed, (d) => props.mode === 'candle' ? d.high : d.close)
  const yPad = (yMax - yMin) * 0.05 || 1
  const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([yMin - yPad, yMax + yPad]).range([h, 0])

  const first = parsed[0]?.close
  const last = parsed[parsed.length - 1]?.close
  const isUp = last >= first
  const color = isUp ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444'

  // Grid
  g.append('g')
    .call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(4).tickSize(-w).tickFormat(''))
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('.tick line').attr('stroke', '#334155').attr('stroke-dasharray', '2,4'))

  if (props.mode === 'candle') {
    const bandW = Math.max(1, (w / parsed.length) * 0.6)

    // Wicks
    g.selectAll('.wick')
      .data(parsed)
      .enter().append('line')
      .attr('x1', (d) => x(d.date))
      .attr('x2', (d) => x(d.date))
      .attr('y1', (d) => y(d.high))
      .attr('y2', (d) => y(d.low))
      .attr('stroke', (d) => d.close >= d.open ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444')
      .attr('stroke-width', 1)

    // Bodies
    g.selectAll('.candle')
      .data(parsed)
      .enter().append('rect')
      .attr('x', (d) => x(d.date) - bandW / 2)
      .attr('y', (d) => y(Math.max(d.open, d.close)))
      .attr('width', bandW)
      .attr('height', (d) => Math.max(1, Math.abs(y(d.open) - y(d.close))))
      .attr('fill', (d) => d.close >= d.open ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444')

  } else {
    // Area fill
    g.append('path')
      .datum(parsed)
      .attr('fill', isUp ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)')
      .attr('d', d3.area().x((d) => x(d.date)).y0(h).y1((d) => y(d.close)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX))

    // Line
    g.append('path')
      .datum(parsed)
      .attr('fill', 'none')
      .attr('stroke', color)
      .attr('stroke-width', 1.5)
      .attr('d', d3.line().x((d) => x(d.date)).y((d) => y(d.close)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX))
  }

  // X axis
  g.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(0,${h})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(x).ticks(5).tickFormat(d3.timeFormat('%b %d')))
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('.tick line').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('text').attr('fill', '#94a3b8').attr('font-size', '10'))

  // Y axis
  g.append('g')
    .call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(4).tickFormat((d) => `$${d3.format(',.0f')(d)}`))
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('.tick line').remove())
    .call((g) => g.selectAll('text').attr('fill', '#94a3b8').attr('font-size', '10'))

  // Crosshair + tooltip
  const bisect = d3.bisector((d) => d.date).left
  const focus = g.append('g').style('display', 'none')
  focus.append('line').attr('y1', 0).attr('y2', h)
    .attr('stroke', '#94a3b8').attr('stroke-dasharray', '3,3').attr('stroke-width', 1)
  focus.append('circle').attr('r', 4).attr('fill', color).attr('stroke', '#0f172a').attr('stroke-width', 2)

  const tooltip = d3.select(tooltipRef.value)

  svg.append('rect')
    .attr('width', W).attr('height', H).attr('fill', 'none').attr('pointer-events', 'all')
    .on('mousemove touchmove', (event) => {
      const [mx] = d3.pointer(event)
      const date = x.invert(mx - margin.left)
      const i = bisect(parsed, date, 1)
      const d0 = parsed[i - 1]; const d1 = parsed[i]
      if (!d0 && !d1) return
      const d = d1 && date - d0?.date > d1?.date - date ? d1 : d0
      if (!d) return

      focus.style('display', null)
      focus.select('circle').attr('cx', x(d.date)).attr('cy', y(d.close))
      focus.select('line').attr('x1', x(d.date)).attr('x2', x(d.date))

      const ohlc = props.mode === 'candle'
        ? `<div class="tt-row"><span>O</span><span>${d.open?.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
           <div class="tt-row"><span>H</span><span>${d.high?.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
           <div class="tt-row"><span>L</span><span>${d.low?.toFixed(2)}</span></div>
           <div class="tt-row"><span>C</span><span>${d.close?.toFixed(2)}</span></div>`
        : `<div class="tt-price">${d.close?.toFixed(2)}</div>`

      tooltip
        .style('display', 'block')
        .style('left', `${Math.min(x(d.date) + margin.left + 10, W - 130)}px`)
        .style('top', `${y(d.close) + margin.top - 10}px`)
        .html(`<div class="tt-date">${new Date(d.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}</div>${ohlc}`)
    })
    .on('mouseleave touchend', () => { focus.style('display', 'none'); tooltip.style('display', 'none') })
}

onMounted(() => nextTick(draw))
watch(() => [props.data, props.loading, props.mode], () => nextTick(draw))

const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => nextTick(draw))
onMounted(() => { if (containerRef.value) ro.observe(containerRef.value) })
onUnmounted(() => ro.disconnect())
</script>

<template>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useTickerCurrency, usePercent, useLargeNumber, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import { useWatchlistStore } from '@/stores/watchlist'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import SelectButton from 'primevue/selectbutton'
import StockChart from '@/components/charts/StockChart.vue'
import AddTransactionModal from '@/components/ui/AddTransactionModal.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const toast = useToast()
const watchlist = useWatchlistStore()

const ticker = ref(route.params.ticker?.toUpperCase())
const quote = ref(null)
const history = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)
const chartLoading = ref(false)
const showTxModal = ref(false)

const ranges = ['1d', '5d', '1mo', '3mo', '6mo', '1y']
const selectedRange = ref('3mo')
const chartMode = ref('line')
const chartModes = ['line', 'candle']

let refreshTimer = null

async function loadQuote() {
  try {
    quote.value = await api.get(`/stocks/quote/${ticker.value}`)
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Failed to refresh', detail: err.message, life: 2000 })
  }
}

async function loadHistory() {
  chartLoading.value = true
  try {
    history.value = await api.get(`/stocks/history/${ticker.value}?range=${selectedRange.value}`)
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Failed to load chart', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    chartLoading.value = false
  }
}

async function loadData() {
  loading.value = true
  await Promise.all([loadQuote(), loadHistory()])
  loading.value = false
}

function startAutoRefresh() {
  clearInterval(refreshTimer)
  refreshTimer = setInterval(loadQuote, 60000)
}

onMounted(() => { loadData(); startAutoRefresh() })
onUnmounted(() => clearInterval(refreshTimer))
watch(selectedRange, loadHistory)
watch(() => route.params.ticker, (t) => {
  ticker.value = t?.toUpperCase()
  loadData()
  startAutoRefresh()
})

async function toggleWatchlist() {
  const existing = watchlist.items.find((i) => i.ticker === ticker.value)
  if (existing) {
    await watchlist.removeItem(existing._id)
    toast.add({ severity: 'info', summary: 'Removed from watchlist', life: 2000 })
  } else {
    await watchlist.addItem(ticker.value, quote.value?.name)
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Added to watchlist', life: 2000 })
  }
}

const isWatched = () => watchlist.items.some((i) => i.ticker === ticker.value)
</script>

<template>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
import * as d3 from 'd3'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'

const props = defineProps({
  positions: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
})

const router = useRouter()
const svgRef = ref(null)
const containerRef = ref(null)

function draw() {
  if (!svgRef.value || !props.positions.length) return

  const svg = d3.select(svgRef.value)
  svg.selectAll('*').remove()

  const sorted = [...props.positions]
    .filter((p) => p.changePercent != null)
    .sort((a, b) => b.changePercent - a.changePercent)

  const top = [
    ...sorted.slice(0, 3),
    ...sorted.slice(-Math.min(3, sorted.length)).reverse(),
  ].filter((v, i, a) => a.findIndex(x => x.ticker === v.ticker) === i)

  if (!top.length) return

  const W = containerRef.value.clientWidth
  const margin = { top: 4, right: 60, bottom: 4, left: 70 }
  const rowH = 32
  const H = top.length * rowH + margin.top + margin.bottom

  svg.attr('width', W).attr('height', H)
  const g = svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`)

  const w = W - margin.left - margin.right
  const maxAbs = d3.max(top, (d) => Math.abs(d.changePercent)) || 1
  const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-maxAbs, maxAbs]).range([0, w])
  const y = d3.scaleBand().domain(top.map(d => d.ticker)).range([0, H - margin.top - margin.bottom]).padding(0.25)

  const zero = x(0)

  // Zero line
  g.append('line')
    .attr('x1', zero).attr('x2', zero)
    .attr('y1', 0).attr('y2', H - margin.top - margin.bottom)
    .attr('stroke', '#334155').attr('stroke-width', 1)

  // Bars
  g.selectAll('.bar')
    .data(top)
    .enter().append('rect')
    .attr('class', 'bar')
    .attr('x', (d) => d.changePercent >= 0 ? zero : x(d.changePercent))
    .attr('y', (d) => y(d.ticker))
    .attr('width', (d) => Math.abs(x(d.changePercent) - zero))
    .attr('height', y.bandwidth())
    .attr('fill', (d) => d.changePercent >= 0 ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444')
    .attr('rx', 3)
    .style('cursor', 'pointer')
    .on('click', (_, d) => router.push(`/stock/${d.ticker}`))

  // Ticker labels
  g.selectAll('.label')
    .data(top)
    .enter().append('text')
    .attr('x', -6).attr('y', (d) => y(d.ticker) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
    .attr('text-anchor', 'end').attr('dominant-baseline', 'middle')
    .attr('fill', '#f1f5f9').attr('font-size', '12').attr('font-weight', '600')
    .text((d) => d.ticker)
    .style('cursor', 'pointer')
    .on('click', (_, d) => router.push(`/stock/${d.ticker}`))

  // Percent labels
  g.selectAll('.pct')
    .data(top)
    .enter().append('text')
    .attr('x', (d) => d.changePercent >= 0 ? x(d.changePercent) + 4 : x(d.changePercent) - 4)
    .attr('y', (d) => y(d.ticker) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
    .attr('text-anchor', (d) => d.changePercent >= 0 ? 'start' : 'end')
    .attr('dominant-baseline', 'middle')
    .attr('fill', (d) => d.changePercent >= 0 ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444')
    .attr('font-size', '11')
    .text((d) => `${d.changePercent >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.changePercent.toFixed(2)}%`)
}

onMounted(() => nextTick(draw))
watch(() => props.positions, () => nextTick(draw), { deep: true })

const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => nextTick(draw))
onMounted(() => { if (containerRef.value) ro.observe(containerRef.value) })
</script>

<template>
  <div v-if="positions.length" ref="containerRef" class="movers-wrap">
    <svg ref="svgRef" style="display:block;width:100%;" />
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.movers-wrap { width: 100%; }
</style>
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, computed } from 'vue'
import { useTickerCurrency, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Tag from 'primevue/tag'
import Select from 'primevue/select'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import InputText from 'primevue/inputtext'

const transactions = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)
const filterTicker = ref('')
const filterType = ref(null)

const typeOptions = [
  { label: 'All types', value: null },
  { label: 'Buy', value: 'buy' },
  { label: 'Sell', value: 'sell' },
]

onMounted(fetchTransactions)

async function fetchTransactions() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const data = await api.get('/portfolio/transactions?limit=500')
    transactions.value = data.transactions
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

const filtered = computed(() => {
  return transactions.value.filter((tx) => {
    const tickerMatch = !filterTicker.value || tx.ticker.includes(filterTicker.value.toUpperCase())
    const typeMatch = !filterType.value || tx.type === filterType.value
    return tickerMatch && typeMatch
  })
})

function formatDate(d) {
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
}

function exportCSV() {
  const rows = [
    ['Date', 'Ticker', 'Type', 'Shares', 'Price', 'Total'],
    ...filtered.value.map((tx) => [
      formatDate(tx.date),
      tx.ticker,
      tx.type,
      tx.shares,
      tx.price,
      tx.total,
    ]),
  ]
  const csv = rows.map((r) => r.join(',')).join('\n')
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' })
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = url
  a.download = `transactions_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`
  a.click()
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="transactions">
    <header class="page-header">
      <h1>History</h1>
      <Button icon="pi pi-download" label="CSV" size="small" outlined @click="exportCSV" :disabled="!filtered.length" />
    </header>

    <!-- Filters -->
    <div class="filters">
      <InputText
        v-model="filterTicker"
        placeholder="Filter ticker..."
        size="small"
        class="filter-input"
      />
      <Select
        v-model="filterType"
        :options="typeOptions"
        option-label="label"
        option-value="value"
        size="small"
        class="filter-select"
      />
    </div>

    <div v-if="loading" class="text-muted loading">Loading...</div>

    <div v-else-if="!filtered.length" class="empty">
      <i class="pi pi-list" />
      <p class="text-muted">No transactions found</p>
    </div>

    <div v-else class="tx-list">
      <div v-for="tx in filtered" :key="tx._id" class="tx-row">
        <div class="tx-left">
          <span class="ticker">{{ tx.ticker }}</span>
          <span class="tx-date text-muted">{{ formatDate(tx.date) }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="tx-mid">
          <span class="text-muted">{{ tx.shares }} × {{ useTickerCurrency(tx.price, tx.ticker) }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="tx-right">
          <Tag :value="tx.type.toUpperCase()" :severity="tx.type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'" />
          <span class="total" :class="tx.type === 'sell' ? 'gain' : ''">
            {{ tx.type === 'sell' ? '+' : '-' }}{{ useTickerCurrency(tx.total, tx.ticker) }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p v-if="filtered.length" class="count text-muted">{{ filtered.length }} transaction{{ filtered.length !== 1 ? 's' : '' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.transactions { padding: 1rem; }
.page-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.page-header h1 { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; }

.filters { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.filter-input { flex: 1; }
.filter-select { width: 130px; }

.loading { padding: 1rem 0; }
.empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 3rem 1rem; }
.empty i { font-size: 3rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }

.tx-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.tx-row { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); gap: 0.5rem; }
.tx-left { flex: 0 0 90px; }
.ticker { font-weight: 600; display: block; font-size: 0.95rem; }
.tx-date { font-size: 0.75rem; }
.tx-mid { flex: 1; font-size: 0.82rem; }
.tx-right { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; }
.total { font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; }
.count { margin-top: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.8rem; text-align: center; }
</style>
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-02 22:15:03Z)**_

The issue is POLI.TA prices from Yahoo Finance are in **agorot** (Israeli cents) — 1 shekel = 100 agorot. So ₪6,940 agorot = ₪69.40 actual price. Your 243 shares × 6,940 = ₪1,686,420 but the real value is ₪16,864.20.

Need to divide `.TA` prices by 100 in the stock service:

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, computed } from 'vue'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { usePortfolioStore } from '@/stores/portfolio'
import { tickerCurrency } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog'
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber'
import DatePicker from 'primevue/datepicker'
import SelectButton from 'primevue/selectbutton'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import AutoComplete from 'primevue/autocomplete'

const props = defineProps({
  visible: Boolean,
  defaultTicker: { type: String, default: '' },
})
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible'])

const toast = useToast()
const portfolio = usePortfolioStore()

const type = ref('buy')
const ticker = ref('')
const shares = ref(null)
const price = ref(null)
const date = ref(new Date())
const notes = ref('')
const loading = ref(false)
const suggestions = ref([])

const currentTicker = computed(() => {
  const t = typeof ticker.value === 'object' ? ticker.value.value : ticker.value
  return t || ''
})
const currency = computed(() => tickerCurrency(currentTicker.value))
const currencySymbol = computed(() => currency.value === 'ILS' ? '₪' : '$')

watch(() => props.visible, (v) => {
  if (v) {
    ticker.value = props.defaultTicker || ''
    shares.value = null
    price.value = null
    date.value = new Date()
    notes.value = ''
    type.value = 'buy'
  }
})

async function searchTicker(event) {
  if (!event.query || event.query.length < 1) { suggestions.value = []; return }
  try {
    const results = await api.get(`/stocks/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(event.query)}`)
    suggestions.value = results.map((r) => ({ label: `${r.ticker} — ${r.name}`, value: r.ticker }))
  } catch { suggestions.value = [] }
}

async function submit() {
  const t = typeof ticker.value === 'object' ? ticker.value.value : ticker.value
  if (!t || !shares.value || !price.value) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Fill all fields', life: 2000 })
    return
  }
  loading.value = true
  try {
    await portfolio.addTransaction({
      ticker: t,
      type: type.value,
      shares: shares.value,
      price: price.value,
      date: date.value,
      notes: notes.value || undefined,
    })
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: `${type.value === 'buy' ? 'Bought' : 'Sold'} ${t}`, life: 2000 })
    emit('update:visible', false)
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog
    :visible="visible"
    @update:visible="emit('update:visible', $event)"
    modal
    :header="type === 'buy' ? 'Buy Stock' : 'Sell Stock'"
    :style="{ width: '95vw', maxWidth: '420px' }"
    :draggable="false"
  >
    <div class="tx-form">
      <SelectButton v-model="type" :options="['buy', 'sell']" class="type-select" />

      <div class="field">
        <label>Ticker</label>
        <AutoComplete
          v-model="ticker"
          :suggestions="suggestions"
          option-label="label"
          @complete="searchTicker"
          placeholder="AAPL, TSLA..."
          fluid
          force-selection
        />
      </div>

      <div class="fields-row">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Shares</label>
          <InputNumber v-model="shares" :min="0.001" :max-fraction-digits="4" placeholder="0" fluid />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Price per share</label>
          <InputNumber v-model="price" mode="currency" :currency="currency" :min="0.001" :max-fraction-digits="4" :placeholder="`${currencySymbol}0.00`" fluid />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Date</label>
        <DatePicker v-model="date" :max-date="new Date()" date-format="dd/mm/yy" show-icon fluid />
      </div>

      <div class="total-row" v-if="shares && price">
        <span class="text-muted">Total</span>
        <span class="total-amount">{{ currencySymbol }}{{ (shares * price).toFixed(2) }}</span>
      </div>

      <Button
        :label="type === 'buy' ? 'Buy' : 'Sell'"
        :severity="type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'"
        :loading="loading"
        fluid
        @click="submit"
      />
    </div>
  </Dialog>
</template>

<style scoped>
.tx-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
.type-select { align-self: center; }
.fields-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.75rem; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }
.field label { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.total-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); font-size: 0.9rem; }
.total-amount { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; }
</style>
```
