```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useTickerCurrency, usePercent, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import Tag from 'primevue/tag'
import AddTransactionModal from '@/components/ui/AddTransactionModal.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const toast = useToast()

const ticker = route.params.ticker.toUpperCase()
const transactions = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)
const showModal = ref(false)

onMounted(fetchLots)

async function fetchLots() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const data = await api.get(`/portfolio/transactions?ticker=${ticker}&limit=500`)
    transactions.value = data.transactions.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date))
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Failed to load', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

// Compute running weighted average after each transaction
const lots = computed(() => {
  let shares = 0
  let totalCost = 0
  return transactions.value.map((tx) => {
    if (tx.type === 'buy') {
      totalCost += tx.shares * tx.price
      shares += tx.shares
    } else {
      totalCost -= (totalCost / shares) * tx.shares
      shares -= tx.shares
    }
    const avgCost = shares > 0 ? totalCost / shares : 0
    return { ...tx, runningShares: shares, runningAvg: avgCost }
  })
})

const summary = computed(() => {
  if (!lots.value.length) return null
  const last = lots.value[lots.value.length - 1]
  return { shares: last.runningShares, avgCost: last.runningAvg }
})

function formatDate(d) {
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="position-detail">
    <header class="page-header">
      <Button icon="pi pi-arrow-left" text rounded @click="router.back()" />
      <div class="header-info">
        <h1>{{ ticker }}</h1>
        <span class="text-muted">Transaction Lots</span>
      </div>
      <Button icon="pi pi-plus" rounded text @click="showModal = true" />
    </header>

    <!-- Summary -->
    <div v-if="summary" class="summary-card">
      <div class="summary-item">
        <span class="text-muted">Total Shares</span>
        <span class="val">{{ summary.shares.toFixed(4).replace(/\.?0+$/, '') }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="summary-item">
        <span class="text-muted">Avg Cost</span>
        <span class="val">{{ useTickerCurrency(summary.avgCost, ticker) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="summary-item">
        <span class="text-muted">Total Cost</span>
        <span class="val">{{ useTickerCurrency(summary.shares * summary.avgCost, ticker) }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="loading" class="text-muted loading">Loading...</div>

    <div v-else-if="!lots.length" class="empty">
      <i class="pi pi-list" />
      <p class="text-muted">No transactions yet</p>
      <Button label="Add Transaction" @click="showModal = true" />
    </div>

    <div v-else class="lots-list">
      <h2 class="section-title">Lots</h2>
      <div v-for="lot in lots" :key="lot._id" class="lot-row">
        <div class="lot-left">
          <div class="lot-top">
            <Tag :value="lot.type.toUpperCase()" :severity="lot.type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'" class="lot-tag" />
            <span class="lot-date text-muted">{{ formatDate(lot.date) }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="lot-detail">
            {{ lot.shares }} shares @ {{ useTickerCurrency(lot.price, ticker) }}
          </div>
          <div v-if="lot.notes" class="lot-notes text-muted">{{ lot.notes }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="lot-right">
          <span class="lot-total">{{ useTickerCurrency(lot.total, ticker) }}</span>
          <span class="lot-avg text-muted">Avg → {{ useTickerCurrency(lot.runningAvg, ticker) }}</span>
          <span class="lot-shares text-muted">{{ lot.runningShares.toFixed(2) }} shares</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <AddTransactionModal
      v-model:visible="showModal"
      :default-ticker="ticker"
      @update:visible="if (!$event) fetchLots()"
    />
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.position-detail { padding: 0.5rem 1rem 2rem; }
.page-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.header-info { flex: 1; }
.header-info h1 { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
.header-info span { font-size: 0.82rem; }

.summary-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  background: var(--bg-card);

}

}
```

```vue
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useTickerCurrency, usePercent, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import Tag from 'primevue/tag'
import AddTransactionModal from '@/components/ui/AddTransactionModal.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const toast = useToast()

const ticker = route.params.ticker.toUpperCase()
const transactions = ref([])
const currentPrice = ref(null)
const loading = ref(false)
const showModal = ref(false)

onMounted(async () => {
  await fetchLots()
  fetchQuote()
})

async function fetchLots() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const data = await api.get(`/portfolio/transactions?ticker=${ticker}&limit=500`)
    transactions.value = data.transactions.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date))
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Failed to load', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function fetchQuote() {
  try {
    const q = await api.get(`/stocks/quote/${ticker}`)
    currentPrice.value = q.price
  } catch {}
}

// Compute running weighted average after each transaction
const lots = computed(() => {
  let shares = 0
  let totalCost = 0
  return transactions.value.map((tx) => {
    if (tx.type === 'buy') {
      totalCost += tx.shares * tx.price
      shares += tx.shares
    } else {
      // on sell, reduce cost basis proportionally
      totalCost -= (totalCost / shares) * tx.shares
      shares -= tx.shares
    }
    const avgCost = shares > 0 ? totalCost / shares : 0
    return { ...tx, runningShares: shares, runningAvg: avgCost }
  })
})

const summary = computed(() => {
  if (!lots.value.length) return null
  const last = lots.value[lots.value.length - 1]
  const shares = last.runningShares
  const avgCost = last.runningAvg
  const totalCost = shares * avgCost
  const currentValue = currentPrice.value != null ? shares * currentPrice.value : null
  const pnl = currentValue != null ? currentValue - totalCost : null
  // % gain = (current - avg) / avg  — this is your 50% example
  const pnlPercent = avgCost > 0 && currentPrice.value != null
    ? ((currentPrice.value - avgCost) / avgCost) * 100
    : null
  return { shares, avgCost, totalCost, currentValue, pnl, pnlPercent }
})

function formatDate(d) {
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="position-detail">
    <header class="page-header">
      <Button icon="pi pi-arrow-left" text rounded @click="router.back()" />
      <div class="header-info">
        <h1>{{ ticker }}</h1>
        <span class="text-muted">Transaction Lots</span>
      </div>
      <Button icon="pi pi-plus" rounded text @click="showModal = true" />
    </header>

    <!-- P&L Summary -->
    <div v-if="summary" class="pnl-card" :class="gainLossClass(summary.pnl)">
      <div class="pnl-main">
        <span class="pnl-label">Overall P&L</span>
        <span class="pnl-value" :class="gainLossClass(summary.pnl)">
          {{ summary.pnl != null ? (summary.pnl >= 0 ? '+' : '') + useTickerCurrency(summary.pnl, ticker) : '—' }}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="pnl-pct" :class="gainLossClass(summary.pnlPercent)">
        {{ summary.pnlPercent != null ? (summary.pnlPercent >= 0 ? '+' : '') + summary.pnlPercent.toFixed(2) + '%' : '—' }}
      </div>
      <div class="pnl-formula text-muted">
        Avg {{ useTickerCurrency(summary.avgCost, ticker) }} → Current {{ currentPrice != null ? useTickerCurrency(currentPrice, ticker) : '…' }}
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Stats row -->
    <div v-if="summary" class="stats-row">
      <div class="stat-item">
        <span class="text-muted">Shares</span>
        <span>{{ summary.shares.toFixed(4).replace(/\.?0+$/, '') }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-item">
        <span class="text-muted">Avg Cost</span>
        <span>{{ useTickerCurrency(summary.avgCost, ticker) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-item">
        <span class="text-muted">Total Cost</span>
        <span>{{ useTickerCurrency(summary.totalCost, ticker) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-item">
        <span class="text-muted">Current Value</span>
        <span>{{ summary.currentValue != null ? useTickerCurrency(summary.currentValue, ticker) : '…' }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="loading" class="text-muted loading">Loading...</div>

    <div v-else-if="!lots.length" class="empty">
      <i class="pi pi-list" />
      <p class="text-muted">No transactions yet</p>
      <Button label="Add Transaction" @click="showModal = true" />
    </div>

    <div v-else class="lots-list">
      <h2 class="section-title">Lots</h2>
      <div v-for="lot in lots" :key="lot._id" class="lot-row">
        <div class="lot-left">
          <div class="lot-top">
            <Tag :value="lot.type.toUpperCase()" :severity="lot.type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'" class="lot-tag" />
            <span class="lot-date text-muted">{{ formatDate(lot.date) }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="lot-detail">
            {{ lot.shares }} shares @ {{ useTickerCurrency(lot.price, ticker) }}
          </div>
          <div v-if="lot.notes" class="lot-notes text-muted">{{ lot.notes }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="lot-right">
          <span class="lot-total">{{ useTickerCurrency(lot.total, ticker) }}</span>
          <span class="lot-avg text-muted">Avg → {{ useTickerCurrency(lot.runningAvg, ticker) }}</span>
          <span class="lot-shares text-muted">{{ lot.runningShares.toFixed(2) }} shares held</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <AddTransactionModal
      v-model:visible="showModal"
      :default-ticker="ticker"
      @hide="fetchLots"
    />
  </div>
</template>
```

```javascript
const FeeProfile = require('../models/FeeProfile')

exports.getProfiles = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const profiles = await FeeProfile.find({ user: req.user._id }).sort({ isDefault: -1, name: 1 })
    res.json(profiles)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.createProfile = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { name, type, value, minFee, currency, isDefault } = req.body
    if (!name || value == null) return res.status(400).json({ message: 'name and value required' })

    if (isDefault) await FeeProfile.updateMany({ user: req.user._id }, { isDefault: false })

    const profile = await FeeProfile.create({
      user: req.user._id, name, type: type || 'percent', value, minFee: minFee || 0,
      currency: currency || 'USD', isDefault: !!isDefault,
    })
    res.status(201).json(profile)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.updateProfile = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const profile = await FeeProfile.findOne({ _id: req.params.id, user: req.user._id })
    if (!profile) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Not found' })

    const { name, type, value, minFee, currency, isDefault } = req.body
    if (isDefault) await FeeProfile.updateMany({ user: req.user._id }, { isDefault: false })

    Object.assign(profile, { name, type, value, minFee, currency, isDefault: !!isDefault })
    await profile.save()
    res.json(profile)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.deleteProfile = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const profile = await FeeProfile.findOne({ _id: req.params.id, user: req.user._id })
    if (!profile) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Not found' })
    await profile.deleteOne()
    res.json({ message: 'Deleted' })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

// Utility: compute fee amount for a given total
exports.computeFee = (profile, total) => {
  if (!profile) return 0
  let fee = profile.type === 'percent' ? (total * profile.value) / 100 : profile.value
  if (profile.minFee && fee < profile.minFee) fee = profile.minFee
  return Math.round(fee * 100) / 100
}
```

```javascript
  const profiles = ref([])
  const loading = ref(false)

  async function fetchProfiles() {
    loading.value = true
    try {
      profiles.value = await api.get('/fee-profiles')
    } finally {
      loading.value = false
    }
  }

  async function createProfile(payload) {
    const p = await api.post('/fee-profiles', payload)
    profiles.value.unshift(p)
    return p
  }

  async function updateProfile(id, payload) {
    const p = await api.put(`/fee-profiles/${id}`, payload)
    const idx = profiles.value.findIndex((x) => x._id === id)
    if (idx !== -1) profiles.value[idx] = p
    return p
  }

  async function deleteProfile(id) {
    await api.delete(`/fee-profiles/${id}`)
    profiles.value = profiles.value.filter((x) => x._id !== id)
  }

  return { profiles, loading, fetchProfiles, createProfile, updateProfile, deleteProfile }
})
```

```vue
import ToggleSwitch from 'primevue/toggleswitch'

const props = defineProps({ visible: Boolean })
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible'])

const toast = useToast()
const store = useFeeProfileStore()

}

onMounted(() => { if (!store.profiles.length) store.fetchProfiles() })

function openNew() { editing.value = 'new'; form.value = defaultForm() }
function openEdit(p) { editing.value = p; form.value = { ...p } }
function closeEdit() { editing.value = null }

async function save() {
  if (!form.value.name || form.value.value == null) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Name and fee value required', life: 2000 }); return

    }
    closeEdit()
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: err.message, life: 3000 })
  }
}

async function remove(p) {
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { usePortfolioStore } from '@/stores/portfolio'
import { useFeeProfileStore } from '@/stores/feeProfiles'
import { tickerCurrency } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog'
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber'
import InputText from 'primevue/inputtext'
import DatePicker from 'primevue/datepicker'
import SelectButton from 'primevue/selectbutton'
import Select from 'primevue/select'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import AutoComplete from 'primevue/autocomplete'

const props = defineProps({
  visible: Boolean,
  defaultTicker: { type: String, default: '' },
})
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'hide'])

const toast = useToast()
const portfolio = usePortfolioStore()
const feeStore = useFeeProfileStore()

const type = ref('buy')
const ticker = ref('')
const shares = ref(null)
const price = ref(null)
const date = ref(new Date())
const notes = ref('')
const selectedFeeProfile = ref(null)
const loading = ref(false)
const suggestions = ref([])

const currentTicker = computed(() => {
  const t = typeof ticker.value === 'object' ? ticker.value.value : ticker.value
  return t || ''
})
const currency = computed(() => tickerCurrency(currentTicker.value))
const currencySymbol = computed(() => currency.value === 'ILS' ? '₪' : '$')

const feeOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: 'No fee', value: null },
  ...feeStore.profiles.map((p) => ({
    label: `${p.name} (${p.type === 'percent' ? p.value + '%' : p.currency + ' ' + p.value})`,
    value: p._id,
    profile: p,
  })),
])

const feeAmount = computed(() => {
  if (!selectedFeeProfile.value || !shares.value || !price.value) return 0
  const opt = feeOptions.value.find((o) => o.value === selectedFeeProfile.value)
  if (!opt?.profile) return 0
  const p = opt.profile
  const total = shares.value * price.value
  let fee = p.type === 'percent' ? (total * p.value) / 100 : p.value
  if (p.minFee && fee < p.minFee) fee = p.minFee
  return Math.round(fee * 100) / 100
})

onMounted(() => { if (!feeStore.profiles.length) feeStore.fetchProfiles() })

watch(() => props.visible, (v) => {
  if (v) {
    ticker.value = props.defaultTicker || ''
    shares.value = null
    price.value = null
    date.value = new Date()
    notes.value = ''
    type.value = 'buy'
    selectedFeeProfile.value = feeStore.profiles.find((p) => p.isDefault)?._id || null
  }
})

async function searchTicker(event) {
  if (!event.query || event.query.length < 1) { suggestions.value = []; return }
  try {
    const results = await api.get(`/stocks/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(event.query)}`)
    suggestions.value = results.map((r) => ({ label: `${r.ticker} — ${r.name}`, value: r.ticker }))
  } catch { suggestions.value = [] }
}

async function submit() {
  const t = typeof ticker.value === 'object' ? ticker.value.value : ticker.value
  if (!t || !shares.value || !price.value) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Fill all fields', life: 2000 })
    return
  }
  loading.value = true
  try {
    await portfolio.addTransaction({
      ticker: t,
      type: type.value,
      shares: shares.value,
      price: price.value,
      date: date.value,
      notes: notes.value || undefined,
      feeProfileId: selectedFeeProfile.value || undefined,
    })
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: `${type.value === 'buy' ? 'Bought' : 'Sold'} ${t}`, life: 2000 })
    emit('update:visible', false)
    emit('hide')
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog
    :visible="visible"
    @update:visible="emit('update:visible', $event)"
    modal
    :header="type === 'buy' ? 'Buy Stock' : 'Sell Stock'"
    :style="{ width: '95vw', maxWidth: '420px' }"
    :draggable="false"
  >
    <div class="tx-form">
      <SelectButton v-model="type" :options="['buy', 'sell']" class="type-select" />

      <div class="field">
        <label>Ticker</label>
        <AutoComplete
          v-model="ticker"
          :suggestions="suggestions"
          option-label="label"
          @complete="searchTicker"
          placeholder="AAPL, TSLA..."
          fluid
          force-selection
        />
      </div>

      <div class="fields-row">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Shares</label>
          <InputNumber v-model="shares" :min="0.001" :max-fraction-digits="4" placeholder="0" fluid />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Price per share</label>
          <InputNumber v-model="price" mode="currency" :currency="currency" :min="0.001" :max-fraction-digits="4" :placeholder="`${currencySymbol}0.00`" fluid />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Date</label>
        <DatePicker v-model="date" :max-date="new Date()" date-format="dd/mm/yy" show-icon fluid />
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Brokerage fee</label>
        <Select
          v-model="selectedFeeProfile"
          :options="feeOptions"
          option-label="label"
          option-value="value"
          placeholder="No fee"
          fluid
        />
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Notes <span class="text-muted">(optional)</span></label>
        <InputText v-model="notes" placeholder="e.g. dividend reinvestment" fluid />
      </div>

      <div class="total-row" v-if="shares && price">
        <div class="total-line">
          <span class="text-muted">Subtotal</span>
          <span>{{ currencySymbol }}{{ (shares * price).toFixed(2) }}</span>
        </div>
        <div v-if="feeAmount > 0" class="total-line fee-line">
          <span class="text-muted">Fee</span>
          <span class="loss">+{{ currencySymbol }}{{ feeAmount.toFixed(2) }}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="total-line total-final">
          <span>Total (incl. fees)</span>
          <span class="total-amount">{{ currencySymbol }}{{ ((shares * price) + feeAmount).toFixed(2) }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button
        :label="type === 'buy' ? 'Buy' : 'Sell'"
        :severity="type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'"
        :loading="loading"
        fluid
        @click="submit"
      />
    </div>
  </Dialog>
</template>
```

```javascript
const FeeProfile = require('../models/FeeProfile')

exports.getProfiles = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const profiles = await FeeProfile.find({ user: req.user._id }).sort({ isDefault: -1, name: 1 })
    res.json(profiles)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.createProfile = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { name, country, currency, buyFee, sellFee, capitalGainsTax, isDefault } = req.body
    if (!name) return res.status(400).json({ message: 'name required' })
    if (isDefault) await FeeProfile.updateMany({ user: req.user._id }, { isDefault: false })
    const profile = await FeeProfile.create({
      user: req.user._id, name, country, currency: currency || 'USD',
      buyFee: buyFee || { type: 'percent', value: 0, minFee: 0 },
      sellFee: sellFee || { type: 'percent', value: 0, minFee: 0 },
      capitalGainsTax: capitalGainsTax || 0,
      isDefault: !!isDefault,
    })
    res.status(201).json(profile)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.updateProfile = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const profile = await FeeProfile.findOne({ _id: req.params.id, user: req.user._id })
    if (!profile) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Not found' })
    const { name, country, currency, buyFee, sellFee, capitalGainsTax, isDefault } = req.body
    if (isDefault) await FeeProfile.updateMany({ user: req.user._id }, { isDefault: false })
    Object.assign(profile, { name, country, currency, buyFee, sellFee, capitalGainsTax, isDefault: !!isDefault })
    await profile.save()
    res.json(profile)
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

exports.deleteProfile = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const profile = await FeeProfile.findOne({ _id: req.params.id, user: req.user._id })
    if (!profile) return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Not found' })
    await profile.deleteOne()
    res.json({ message: 'Deleted' })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: err.message })
  }
}

function calcFee(rule, total) {
  if (!rule || !rule.value) return 0
  let fee = rule.type === 'percent' ? (total * rule.value) / 100 : rule.value
  if (rule.minFee && fee < rule.minFee) fee = rule.minFee
  return Math.round(fee * 100) / 100
}

// avgCost required for sell tax calculation
exports.computeTransactionCosts = (profile, txType, total, shares, price, avgCost) => {
  if (!profile) return { feeAmount: 0, taxAmount: 0 }

  const feeRule = txType === 'buy' ? profile.buyFee : profile.sellFee
  const feeAmount = calcFee(feeRule, total)

  let taxAmount = 0
  if (txType === 'sell' && profile.capitalGainsTax > 0 && avgCost != null) {
    const gain = (price - avgCost) * shares
    if (gain > 0) {
      taxAmount = Math.round((gain * profile.capitalGainsTax) / 100 * 100) / 100
    }
  }

  return { feeAmount, taxAmount }
}

// Keep backward compat alias
exports.computeFee = (profile, total) => calcFee(profile?.buyFee, total)

```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useFeeProfileStore } from '@/stores/feeProfiles'
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import InputText from 'primevue/inputtext'
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber'
import SelectButton from 'primevue/selectbutton'
import ToggleSwitch from 'primevue/toggleswitch'
import Select from 'primevue/select'

const props = defineProps({ visible: Boolean })
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible'])

const toast = useToast()
const store = useFeeProfileStore()

const editing = ref(null)
const form = ref(defaultForm())

const COUNTRIES = [
  { label: 'Israel', value: 'Israel', tax: 25 },
  { label: 'USA', value: 'USA', tax: 20 },
  { label: 'UK', value: 'UK', tax: 20 },
  { label: 'Germany', value: 'Germany', tax: 26.375 },
  { label: 'Other', value: 'Other', tax: 0 },
]

function defaultForm() {
  return {
    name: '',
    country: '',
    currency: 'USD',
    buyFee: { type: 'percent', value: 0, minFee: 0 },
    sellFee: { type: 'percent', value: 0, minFee: 0 },
    capitalGainsTax: 0,
    isDefault: false,
  }
}

onMounted(() => { if (!store.profiles.length) store.fetchProfiles() })

function openNew() { editing.value = 'new'; form.value = defaultForm() }
function openEdit(p) {
  editing.value = p
  form.value = {
    name: p.name,
    country: p.country || '',
    currency: p.currency || 'USD',
    buyFee: { ...p.buyFee },
    sellFee: { ...p.sellFee },
    capitalGainsTax: p.capitalGainsTax || 0,
    isDefault: p.isDefault,
  }
}
function closeEdit() { editing.value = null }

function onCountryChange(val) {
  const c = COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.value === val)
  if (c) form.value.capitalGainsTax = c.tax
}

async function save() {
  if (!form.value.name) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Name required', life: 2000 }); return
  }
  try {
    if (editing.value === 'new') {
      await store.createProfile(form.value)
      toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Fee profile created', life: 2000 })
    } else {
      await store.updateProfile(editing.value._id, form.value)
      toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Updated', life: 2000 })
    }
    closeEdit()
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: err.message, life: 3000 })
  }
}

async function remove(p) {
  try {
    await store.deleteProfile(p._id)
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Deleted', life: 2000 })
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: err.message, life: 3000 })
  }
}

function feeLabel(p) {
  const buy = p.buyFee?.value ? `Buy ${p.buyFee.type === 'percent' ? p.buyFee.value + '%' : p.buyFee.value}` : null
  const sell = p.sellFee?.value ? `Sell ${p.sellFee.type === 'percent' ? p.sellFee.value + '%' : p.sellFee.value}` : null
  const tax = p.capitalGainsTax ? `Tax ${p.capitalGainsTax}%` : null
  return [buy, sell, tax].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'No fees'
}
</script>

  <Dialog

    @update:visible="emit('update:visible', $event)"
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useTickerCurrency, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import Tag from 'primevue/tag'
import AddTransactionModal from '@/components/ui/AddTransactionModal.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const toast = useToast()

const ticker = route.params.ticker.toUpperCase()
const transactions = ref([])
const currentPrice = ref(null)
const loading = ref(false)
const showModal = ref(false)

onMounted(async () => {
  await fetchLots()
  fetchQuote()
})

async function fetchLots() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const data = await api.get(`/portfolio/transactions?ticker=${ticker}&limit=500`)
    transactions.value = data.transactions.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date))
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Failed to load', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function fetchQuote() {
  try {
    const q = await api.get(`/stocks/quote/${ticker}`)
    currentPrice.value = q.price
  } catch {}
}

// Running weighted average per lot
const lots = computed(() => {
  let shares = 0
  let totalCost = 0
  return transactions.value.map((tx) => {
    if (tx.type === 'buy') {
      totalCost += tx.shares * tx.price
      shares += tx.shares
    } else {
      totalCost -= (totalCost / shares) * tx.shares
      shares -= tx.shares
    }
    const avgCost = shares > 0 ? totalCost / shares : 0
    return { ...tx, runningShares: shares, runningAvg: avgCost }
  })
})

// Full summary including all fees and taxes paid
const summary = computed(() => {
  if (!lots.value.length) return null
  const last = lots.value[lots.value.length - 1]
  const shares = last.runningShares
  const avgCost = last.runningAvg
  const totalCost = shares * avgCost

  // Accumulate fees & taxes from all lots
  let totalBuyFees = 0
  let totalSellFees = 0
  let totalTax = 0
  let realizedGross = 0   // sell proceeds before fees/tax
  let realizedNet = 0     // sell proceeds after fees/tax

  for (const tx of transactions.value) {
    if (tx.type === 'buy') {
      totalBuyFees += tx.feeAmount || 0
    } else {
      totalSellFees += tx.feeAmount || 0
      totalTax += tx.taxAmount || 0
      realizedGross += tx.total || 0
      realizedNet += tx.netProceeds != null ? tx.netProceeds : (tx.total - (tx.feeAmount || 0) - (tx.taxAmount || 0))
    }
  }

  const totalFees = totalBuyFees + totalSellFees
  const currentValue = currentPrice.value != null ? shares * currentPrice.value : null

  // Gross P&L = current value - cost basis (ignores fees/tax)
  const grossPnl = currentValue != null ? currentValue - totalCost : null
  const grossPnlPct = avgCost > 0 && currentPrice.value != null
    ? ((currentPrice.value - avgCost) / avgCost) * 100 : null

  // Net P&L = gross P&L - all fees paid - all tax paid (true profit)
  const netPnl = grossPnl != null ? grossPnl - totalFees - totalTax : null
  const netPnlPct = totalCost > 0 && netPnl != null
    ? (netPnl / (totalCost + totalFees)) * 100 : null

  // Estimated future sell tax if sold at current price
  const unrealizedGain = currentValue != null ? currentValue - totalCost : null
  // Tax rate from last used fee profile (if any)
  const taxRate = transactions.value.find(t => t.feeProfile?.capitalGainsTax)?.feeProfile?.capitalGainsTax || 0
  const estimatedTax = unrealizedGain != null && unrealizedGain > 0 && taxRate > 0
    ? Math.round(unrealizedGain * taxRate / 100 * 100) / 100 : 0

  return {
    shares, avgCost, totalCost, currentValue,
    grossPnl, grossPnlPct,
    netPnl, netPnlPct,
    totalBuyFees, totalSellFees, totalFees,
    totalTax, taxRate, estimatedTax,
    realizedGross, realizedNet,
  }
})

function formatDate(d) {
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
}

function fmt(val) {
  return val >= 0 ? '+' : ''
}
</script>
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-03 04:41:36Z)**_

The `force-selection` prop forces users to pick from the dropdown — but if they type a known ticker like `POLI.TA` and don't pick from suggestions, it gets cleared. Also the `option-label="label"` means the selected value shows the full label string, not just the ticker.

The real fix: drop `force-selection`, allow free text input, and still show suggestions. This lets users type a ticker directly OR pick from search results:

The chart uses `p.value` (in native currency) for the pie slices — but for mixed portfolios it should use `p.valueUsd` so the proportions are also correct. Pass `combinedUsd` as a prop:

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-03 05:06:22Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
import * as d3 from 'd3'
import { useCurrency } from '@/composables/useFormat'

const props = defineProps({
  positions: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
  combinedUsd: { type: Object, default: null },
})

const svgRef = ref(null)

const COLORS = ['#3b82f6','#22c55e','#f59e0b','#ef4444','#8b5cf6','#06b6d4','#ec4899','#84cc16']

function draw() {
  if (!svgRef.value || !props.positions.length) return

  const svg = d3.select(svgRef.value)
  svg.selectAll('*').remove()

  const W = 280
  const H = 200
  const radius = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 10
  const innerRadius = radius * 0.55

  svg.attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${W} ${H}`).attr('width', '100%').attr('height', H)

  const g = svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(${W / 2},${H / 2})`)

  const isMixed = props.combinedUsd && props.positions.some(p => p.currency === 'ILS') && props.positions.some(p => p.currency === 'USD')

  // Use USD-converted values for slices when mixed, native value otherwise
  const data = props.positions.map((p, i) => ({
    ticker: p.ticker,
    value: isMixed ? (p.valueUsd || 0) : p.value,
    color: COLORS[i % COLORS.length],
  }))

  const pie = d3.pie().value((d) => d.value).sort(null)
  const arc = d3.arc().innerRadius(innerRadius).outerRadius(radius).cornerRadius(3).padAngle(0.02)
  const hoverArc = d3.arc().innerRadius(innerRadius).outerRadius(radius + 6).cornerRadius(3).padAngle(0.02)

  const arcs = g.selectAll('.arc').data(pie(data)).enter().append('g').attr('class', 'arc')

  arcs.append('path')
    .attr('fill', (d) => d.data.color)
    .attr('d', arc)
    .style('cursor', 'pointer')
    .on('mouseover', function (_, d) { d3.select(this).attr('d', hoverArc) })
    .on('mouseout', function (_, d) { d3.select(this).attr('d', arc) })

  // Center label
  let totalLabel
  if (isMixed) {
    totalLabel = useCurrency(props.combinedUsd.value, 'USD')
  } else {
    const currency = props.positions[0]?.currency || 'USD'
    const total = d3.sum(data, (d) => d.value)
    totalLabel = useCurrency(total, currency)
  }

  g.append('text').attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('dy', '-0.2em')
    .attr('fill', '#94a3b8').attr('font-size', '11')
    .text(isMixed ? 'Total USD' : 'Total')
  g.append('text').attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('dy', '1em')
    .attr('fill', '#f1f5f9').attr('font-size', '12').attr('font-weight', '600')
    .text(totalLabel)
}

onMounted(() => nextTick(draw))
watch(() => [props.positions, props.combinedUsd], () => nextTick(draw), { deep: true })
</script>

<template>
  <div v-if="positions.length" class="allocation-wrap">
    <h2 class="section-title">Allocation</h2>
    <div class="chart-row">
      <svg ref="svgRef" />
      <div class="legend">
        <div v-for="(pos, i) in positions" :key="pos.ticker" class="legend-item">
          <span class="legend-dot" :style="{ background: COLORS[i % COLORS.length] }" />
          <span class="legend-ticker">{{ pos.ticker }}</span>
          <span class="legend-pct text-muted">
            {{ (() => {
              const isMixed = combinedUsd && positions.some(p => p.currency === 'ILS') && positions.some(p => p.currency === 'USD')
              const val = isMixed ? (pos.valueUsd || 0) : pos.value
              const total = positions.reduce((s, p) => s + (isMixed ? (p.valueUsd || 0) : p.value), 0)
              return total > 0 ? (val / total * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : ''
            })() }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
const COLORS = ['#3b82f6','#22c55e','#f59e0b','#ef4444','#8b5cf6','#06b6d4','#ec4899','#84cc16']
</script>
```

```vue
        class="stock-card"

      >
        <div class="stock-top">

          </div>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
import * as d3 from 'd3'

const props = defineProps({
  data: { type: Array, default: () => [] },   // array of { close }
  pnlPercent: { type: Number, default: 0 },
})

const svgRef = ref(null)

function draw() {
  if (!svgRef.value || !props.data.length) return
  const svg = d3.select(svgRef.value)
  svg.selectAll('*').remove()

  const W = svgRef.value.clientWidth || 120
  const H = 40
  svg.attr('width', W).attr('height', H)

  const isWin = props.pnlPercent >= 0
  const color = isWin ? '#00ff88' : '#ff3366'

  const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, props.data.length - 1]).range([0, W])
  const yMin = d3.min(props.data, d => d.close)
  const yMax = d3.max(props.data, d => d.close)
  const yPad = (yMax - yMin) * 0.1 || 1
  const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([yMin - yPad, yMax + yPad]).range([H - 2, 2])

  const line = d3.line()
    .x((_, i) => x(i))
    .y(d => y(d.close))
    .curve(d3.curveMonotoneX)

  // Glow filter
  const defs = svg.append('defs')
  const filterId = `glow-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`
  const filter = defs.append('filter').attr('id', filterId)
  filter.append('feGaussianBlur').attr('stdDeviation', '2.5').attr('result', 'blur')
  const feMerge = filter.append('feMerge')
  feMerge.append('feMergeNode').attr('in', 'blur')
  feMerge.append('feMergeNode').attr('in', 'SourceGraphic')

  // Area fill
  const area = d3.area()
    .x((_, i) => x(i))
    .y0(H)
    .y1(d => y(d.close))
    .curve(d3.curveMonotoneX)

  svg.append('path')
    .datum(props.data)
    .attr('fill', isWin ? 'rgba(0,255,136,0.08)' : 'rgba(255,51,102,0.08)')
    .attr('d', area)

  // Line with glow
  svg.append('path')
    .datum(props.data)
    .attr('fill', 'none')
    .attr('stroke', color)
    .attr('stroke-width', 1.5)
    .attr('filter', `url(#${filterId})`)
    .attr('d', line)
}

onMounted(() => nextTick(draw))
watch(() => [props.data, props.pnlPercent], () => nextTick(draw), { deep: true })
</script>

<template>
  <svg ref="svgRef" class="sparkline" />
</template>

<style scoped>
.sparkline { display: block; width: 100%; height: 40px; }
</style>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, watch, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useFeeProfileStore } from '@/stores/feeProfiles'
import { tickerCurrency } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Dialog from 'primevue/dialog'
import InputNumber from 'primevue/inputnumber'
import InputText from 'primevue/inputtext'
import DatePicker from 'primevue/datepicker'
import Select from 'primevue/select'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import Tag from 'primevue/tag'

const props = defineProps({
  visible: Boolean,
  transaction: { type: Object, default: null },
})
const emit = defineEmits(['update:visible', 'saved'])

const toast = useToast()
const feeStore = useFeeProfileStore()

const shares = ref(null)
const price = ref(null)
const date = ref(new Date())
const notes = ref('')
const selectedFeeProfile = ref(null)
const loading = ref(false)

const ticker = computed(() => props.transaction?.ticker || '')
const currency = computed(() => tickerCurrency(ticker.value))
const currencySymbol = computed(() => currency.value === 'ILS' ? '₪' : '$')

const feeOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: 'No fee', value: null },
  ...feeStore.profiles.map((p) => {
    const fee = props.transaction?.type === 'buy' ? p.buyFee : p.sellFee
    const feeStr = fee?.value ? (fee.type === 'percent' ? `${fee.value}%` : `${p.currency} ${fee.value}`) : '0%'
    const taxStr = p.capitalGainsTax ? ` · Tax ${p.capitalGainsTax}%` : ''
    return { label: `${p.name} (${feeStr}${taxStr})`, value: p._id }
  }),
])

const total = computed(() => shares.value && price.value ? shares.value * price.value : 0)

onMounted(() => { if (!feeStore.profiles.length) feeStore.fetchProfiles() })

watch(() => props.transaction, (tx) => {
  if (!tx) return
  shares.value = tx.shares
  price.value = tx.price
  date.value = tx.date ? new Date(tx.date) : new Date()
  notes.value = tx.notes || ''
  selectedFeeProfile.value = tx.feeProfile?._id || tx.feeProfile || null
}, { immediate: true })

async function save() {
  if (!shares.value || !price.value) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Shares and price required', life: 2000 })
    return
  }
  loading.value = true
  try {
    await api.put(`/portfolio/transaction/${props.transaction._id}`, {
      shares: shares.value,
      price: price.value,
      date: date.value,
      notes: notes.value || undefined,
      feeProfileId: selectedFeeProfile.value || undefined,
    })
    toast.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Transaction updated', life: 2000 })
    emit('update:visible', false)
    emit('saved')
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>

    :visible="visible"
    @update:visible="emit('update:visible', $event)"

      <div class="modal-header">
        <Tag

          :severity="transaction?.type === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'"

    </template>

        <div class="field">

          <InputNumber v-model="shares" :min="0.001" :max-fraction-digits="4" fluid />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Price per share</label>
          <InputNumber
            v-model="price"
            mode="currency"
            :currency="currency"
            :min="0.001"
            :max-fraction-digits="4"

          />

      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Date</label>
        <DatePicker v-model="date" :max-date="new Date()" date-format="dd/mm/yy" show-icon fluid />
```

```css
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --bg-primary: #000000;
  --bg-secondary: #111111;
  --bg-card: #111111;
  --border: #222222;
  --text-primary: #f1f5f9;
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
  --green: #00ff88;
  --red: #ff3366;
  --accent: #3b82f6;
  --neon-green: #00ff88;
  --neon-red: #ff3366;
  --neon-blue: #00cfff;
  --nav-height: 64px;
  --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
}

html, body, #app {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* ── Neon text ── */
.gain { color: var(--neon-green); }
.loss { color: var(--neon-red); }
.text-muted { color: var(--text-secondary); }

/* ── Gradient title ── */
.gradient-title {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00cfff 0%, #a855f7 50%, #ff3366 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

/* ── Neon card borders ── */
.neon-card-gain {
  border-color: rgba(0,255,136,0.5) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,255,136,0.25), inset 0 0 8px rgba(0,255,136,0.04);
}
.neon-card-loss {
  border-color: rgba(255,51,102,0.5) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,51,102,0.25), inset 0 0 8px rgba(255,51,102,0.04);
}

/* ── Neon glow on active nav ── */
.nav-item.active i {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--neon-blue));
}

.safe-bottom { padding-bottom: calc(var(--nav-height) + var(--safe-bottom) + 1rem); }

::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #333; border-radius: 2px; }

```

Data source: Yahoo Finance free API with periodic polling (not WebSockets). Multi-currency support for Israeli TASE market (.TA suffix stocks) and US markets. User explicitly requested implementation of Phases 2, 3, and 4 after Phase 1 scaffolding was complete.

2. Key Technical Concepts:

   - MongoDB with Mongoose ODM
   - JWT authentication with localStorage token storage

   - Yahoo Finance API integration via yahoo-finance2 npm package
   - Multi-currency handling: USD ($) and Israeli Shekel (₪ ILS)
   - TASE (.TA suffix) price conversion from agorot to shekels (divide by 100)
   - Quote caching with 5-minute TTL
   - Bottom navigation UI with 5 tabs for mobile-first layout

     * index.js: Main Express server, MongoDB connection, CORS, rate limiting, cron job startup

     * models/Transaction.js: Buy/sell transaction log

     * controllers/stockController.js: getQuote, getHistory, search endpoints
     * controllers/watchlistController.js: Add/remove from watchlist
     * services/stockService.js: Yahoo Finance integration. **CRITICAL BUG FIX IN PROGRESS**: Added taFactor() to detect .TA tickers and divide prices by 100 (agorot conversion). Applied to getQuote() for all price fields (price, change, dayHigh, dayLow, open, week52High, week52Low, marketCap). STILL NEEDS: Apply same factor to getHistory() for chart data.
     * services/cronService.js: 5-minute poll job during market hours (Mon-Fri 14:00-21:00 UTC = 9:30-16:00 ET)
     * middleware/auth.js: JWT verification middleware
     * .env: MongoDB URI, JWT_SECRET, PORT=3000, CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:5173

     * vite.config.js: Vite + Vue + PWA plugin configuration

   ```javascript
     const result = await yahooFinance.quote(ticker)
     const f = taFactor(ticker)

     const data = {
       ticker: result.symbol,
       name: result.shortName,
       price: result.regularMarketPrice / f,
       change: result.regularMarketChange / f,
       changePercent: result.regularMarketChangePercent,
       volume: result.regularMarketVolume,
       marketCap: result.marketCap != null ? result.marketCap / f : null,
       dayHigh: result.regularMarketDayHigh / f,
       dayLow: result.regularMarketDayLow / f,

       week52High: result.fiftyTwoWeekHigh / f,
       week52Low: result.fiftyTwoWeekLow / f,
       pe: result.trailingPE,
     }
     quoteCache.set(ticker, { data, ts: Date.now() })
     return data
   }
   ```

Sparklines added to Holdings cards. Now to your API question:

## **Data Source: Yahoo Finance**

**API Used:** Yahoo Finance v3 (unofficial but stable)
- **Free tier** — no rate limit restrictions, no auth required
- **Backend fetches via:** `yahoo-finance2` npm package

**Usage Limits:**
- **Quotes** — unlimited requests
- **Historical data** — unlimited requests
- **Caching strategy** — 1-hour TTL on exchange rates, no caching on live quotes (real-time)

**What we fetch:**
- **Live prices** — quote, change, volume, P/E, market cap, 52W high/low
- **Historical** — daily OHLCV for 1d/5d/1mo/3mo/6mo/1y/5y ranges
- **Symbols** — ticker search for US/Israeli markets

**Special handling:**
- **TASE (.TA) stocks** — prices come in agorot (1/100 shekel), we divide by 100 to get shekels
- **FX rates (ILS→USD)** — cached 1 hour, fetched on-demand via historical endpoint

**No limits hit so far** — app can scale freely without worrying about hitting a paid API tier.
